title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
title_zh: DepthWorld：用于机器人操作的3D世界模型

paragraphs.en: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. Closing this gap requires progress on two fronts: large-scale 3D supervision for manipulation, and an architecture that can absorb it without disturbing strong pretrained video priors. We introduce a calibration pipeline that combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph, pooling all episodes collected from the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to the DROID dataset, this yields DROID-3D, a calibrated 3D dataset providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics (achieving < 0.7 <0.7 px reprojection error on 90% of episodes for external cameras). We then train DepthWorld, a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling, leaving the pretrained Variational Autoencoder (VAE) unchanged. Depth supervision improves RGB prediction itself by +1.48 dB PSNR over an identical RGB-only baseline at equal training budget, while simultaneously yielding accurate metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型为机器人领域提供了以数据驱动的传统模拟器的替代方案，其应用涵盖策略评估、改进和规划。 所有这些应用都依赖于精确的三维几何结构，然而当前的视频基世界模型仅基于 RGB 数据进行训练，生成的帧序列虽然逐帧看起来正确，却无法组合成一个连贯的三维世界。 要弥合这一差距，需要在两个方向取得进展：为操作任务提供大规模三维监督数据，以及采用一种能够吸收这些数据而不干扰强预训练视频先验的架构。 我们提出了一种校准流程，将学习到的立体深度与联合因子图相结合，汇集来自同一物理机器人的所有片段，以恢复其共享的运动学参数以及每场景的外参。 将该方法应用于 DROID 数据集后，我们得到了 DROID-3D——一个经过校准的三维数据集，提供了密集的距离度量深度和重新校准的多视角外参（在 90% 的片段中，外部摄像头的重投影误差低于 0.7 像素）。 接着，我们训练了 DepthWorld——一种基于 Stable Video Diffusion 的世界模型，它通过空间潜在图块化技术联合预测多视角 RGB 和深度，同时保持预训练的变分自编码器（VAE）不变。 在相同的训练资源下，深度监督使 RGB 预测本身的 PSNR 提升了 1.48 dB，同时为下游的几何推理提供了精确的距离度量深度。

paragraphs.zh: 关键词：3D 世界模型、机器人、学习

paragraphs.en: World models are a promising data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robot learning, with the potential to simulate manipulation tasks that are difficult to capture with physics-based engines. Recent work has shown that finetuning pretrained video diffusion backbones with action conditioning on large-scale robotics datasets yields models that generate faithful action-consistent rollouts [ 12 , 2 ] . Such rollouts are increasingly used for policy evaluation [ 12 , 2 ] , policy improvement [ 12 , 8 ] , and planning [ 49 , 34 ] —uses in which the geometric fidelity of the rollout determines whether the signal is usable.
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型是机器人学习中一种有前景的数据驱动型传统模拟器替代方案，能够模拟那些难以通过基于物理的引擎捕捉的操作任务。 近期的研究表明，通过在大规模机器人数据集上对预训练的视频扩散模型主干网络进行动作条件微调，可以生成能够产生与动作一致且高度逼真的模拟过程的模型 [ 12 , 2 ] 。 这类模拟过程正越来越多地用于策略评估 [ 12 , 2 ] 、策略改进 [ 12 , 8 ] 和规划 [ 49 , 34 ]——在这些应用中，模拟过程的几何保真度决定了信号是否可用。

sents.en: World models are a promising data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robot learning, with the potential to simulate manipulation tasks that are difficult to capture with physics-based engines.

sents.en: Such rollouts are increasingly used for policy evaluation [ 12 , 2 ] , policy improvement [ 12 , 8 ] , and planning [ 49 , 34 ] —uses in which the geometric fidelity of the rollout determines whether the signal is usable.
sents.zh: 这类模拟过程正越来越多地用于策略评估 [ 12 , 2 ] 、策略改进 [ 12 , 8 ] 和规划 [ 49 , 34 ]——在这些应用中，模拟过程的几何保真度决定了信号是否可用。

paragraphs.en: However, current video world models miss this geometric structure entirely. They are trained on RGB alone, and the training loss provides no signal to resolve the underlying 3D ambiguity of pixel sequences. The resulting models produce visually plausible rollouts whose geometry is internally incoherent: predicted depth disagrees across views of the same scene, the model struggles with geometric reasoning about occlusion and contact (Figure 4 ), and object shape and identity degrade over the course of a rollout (Figure 1 ). For downstream uses that read off the rollout, this incoherence is the limiting factor.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当前的视频世界模型完全忽略了这种几何结构。 它们仅基于 RGB 数据进行训练，而训练损失无法提供任何信号来解决像素序列中潜在的三维歧义。 由此产生的模型能够生成在视觉上看似合理的模拟过程，但其内部几何结构却自相矛盾：同一场景的不同视角中预测的深度不一致，模型难以处理遮挡和接触相关的几何推理（图 4），并且物体形状和身份在整个模拟过程中会逐渐退化（图 1）。 对于依赖读取模拟结果进行后续应用的任务而言，这种不连贯性是最主要的限制因素。

sents.zh: 然而，当前的视频世界模型完全忽略了这种几何结构。

sents.zh: 由此产生的模型能够生成在视觉上看似合理的模拟过程，但其内部几何结构却自相矛盾：同一场景的不同视角中预测的深度不一致，模型难以处理遮挡和接触相关的几何推理（图 4），并且物体形状和身份在整个模拟过程中会逐渐退化（图 1）。

sents.en: For downstream uses that read off the rollout, this incoherence is the limiting factor.
sents.zh: 对于依赖读取模拟结果进行后续应用的任务而言，这种不连贯性是最主要的限制因素。

paragraphs.en: The natural fix is to supervise geometry directly during training, the recipe behind recent geometric foundation models [ 40 , 19 , 39 , 41 , 21 , 17 ] . However, this approach does not directly apply to robot world models for two reasons. First, geometric foundation models earn their generalization by training on datasets that already carry metric depth and calibrated poses [ 45 , 4 , 33 , 20 , 44 , 31 ] . Robot teleoperation datasets such as DROID [ 18 ] capture the appearance and dynamics of real manipulation at scale, but their geometric annotations are secondary outputs of the collection pipeline and not at the quality geometric pretraining demands. Lifting them into supervision-quality 3D is non-trivial: manipulation scenes are dominated by textureless and specular surfaces, and even a rig that is internally self-consistent under bundle adjustment can be kinematically decoupled from from the robot’s own coordinate frame, severing the critical link to the robot’s proprioception and end-effector actions. Second, current video world models rely on delicate, pretrained image and video diffusion priors. Conventional architectural modifications for incorporating spatial modalities—such as expanding the input channels of the VAE or introducing parallel dual-branch U-Nets—require destructive weight re-initializations. These interventions risk corrupting the strong visual and motion priors that make these foundation backbones effective in the first place.
paragraphs.zh: 一种自然的解决方案是在训练期间直接对几何结构进行监督，这也是近期几何基础模型 [ 40 , 19 , 39 , 41 , 21 , 17 ] 所采用的方法。 然而，由于两个原因，这种方法无法直接应用于机器人世界模型。 首先，几何基础模型通过在已包含度量深度和校准姿态的数据集上进行训练来实现泛化能力 [ 45 , 4 , 33 , 20 , 44 , 31 ] 。 像 DROID [ 18 ] 这样的机器人远程操作数据集能够大规模捕捉真实操作的外观和动态，但其几何标注只是采集流程的次要输出，质量尚达不到几何预训练的要求。 将这些标注提升至监督质量的 3D 水平并非易事：操作场景主要由无纹理和镜面反射的表面构成，即使一个在束调整下内部自洽的骨架，也可能在运动学上与机器人自身的坐标框架解耦，从而切断其与机器人本体感知和末端执行器动作之间的关键联系。 其次，当前的视频世界模型依赖于精细的、经过预训练的图像和视频扩散先验。 为引入空间模态而进行的传统架构修改——例如扩展 VAE 的输入通道或引入平行的双分支 U-Net——都需要对权重进行破坏性重新初始化。 这些干预措施可能会破坏这些基础模型主干之所以有效的关键视觉和运动先验。

paragraphs.en: We address both through the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过以下贡献同时解决了这两个问题：

paragraphs.en: We introduce a calibration pipeline for recovering metric depth and accurate multi-view extrinsics from any multi-view stereo teleoperation collection with a known URDF. The pipeline combines learned stereo depth with a joint factor graph optimization that pools all episodes of the same physical robot to recover its shared kinematic parameters (joint offsets, hand-eye calibration) alongside per-scene extrinsics. Applied to DROID [ 18 ] , this yields DROID-3D —a calibrated 3D corpus providing dense metric depth and recalibrated multi-view extrinsics for over 70,000 episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种校准流程，用于从任何具有已知 URDF 的多视角立体远程操作数据集中恢复度量深度和精确的多视角外参。 该流程将学习到的立体深度与联合因子图优化相结合，通过汇集同一物理机器人的所有片段，恢复其共享的运动学参数（关节偏移量、手眼校准），同时获取每个场景的外参。 将此方法应用于 DROID [ 18 ]，得到了 DROID-3D——一个经过校准的 3D 数据集，为超过 70,000 个片段提供了密集的度量深度和重新校准的多视角外参。

paragraphs.en: We train DepthWorld , a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling that leaves the pretrained VAE unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 我们训练了 DepthWorld，这是一个基于 Stable Video Diffusion 的世界模型，它通过空间潜在图块化技术联合预测多视角 RGB 图像和深度信息，同时保持预训练的 VAE 不变。

paragraphs.en: We show that depth supervision improves RGB prediction : at equal training budget, DepthWorld gains + 1.48 +1.48 dB PSNR over an RGB-only baseline of identical architecture and data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了深度监督能够提升 RGB 预测效果：在训练预算相同的情况下，DepthWorld 相较于采用相同架构和数据的纯 RGB 基线模型，PSNR 提升了 +1.48 dB。

paragraphs.en: Robotic World Models. Action-conditioned video models have emerged as a learned substitute for physics-based simulators in manipulation, with applications spanning policy evaluation [ 12 , 2 ] , policy improvement [ 12 , 8 ] , and visual planning [ 49 , 34 ] . Recent works finetune pretrained video diffusion backbones with proprioceptive action conditioning: Ctrl-World [ 12 ] , an SVD-based controllable world model trained on DROID [ 18 ] forms our backbone; IRASim [ 51 ] along with other works [ 15 ] systematize the policy-evaluation use case. All these uses presuppose geometrically faithful rollouts. Current video world models are trained on RGB alone, which does not generally serve as a strong geometric prior. We close this gap by jointly predicting depth and supervising with point maps.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人世界模型。 以动作作为条件的视频模型已成为物理模拟器的学习替代方案，被广泛应用于操控任务，涵盖策略评估 [ 12 , 2 ]、策略改进 [ 12 , 8 ] 和视觉规划 [ 49 , 34 ] 等多个领域。 近期的研究通过本体感觉动作条件对预训练的视频扩散模型主干网络进行微调：Ctrl-World [ 12 ] 是一种基于 SVD 的可控世界模型，在 DROID [ 18 ] 数据集上训练而成，构成了我们的主干网络；IRASim [ 51 ] 及其他研究 [ 15 ] 则系统化了策略评估这一应用场景。 所有这些应用都预设了几何结构忠实的模拟过程。 当前的视频世界模型仅基于 RGB 图像进行训练，而 RGB 图像通常无法提供强有力的几何先验信息。 我们通过联合预测深度并使用点云地图进行监督，从而填补了这一空白。

paragraphs.en: Geometric Foundation Models. A recent line of work regresses dense metric geometry directly from images: DUSt3R [ 40 ] and MASt3R [ 19 ] predict point maps from image pairs, VGGT [ 39 ] scales this to many-view inputs through intermediate camera and DPT [ 32 ] heads, and MapAnything [ 17 ] unifies a broader class of supervision targets. These models inherit their generalization from large datasets [ 45 , 4 , 33 , 20 , 44 , 31 , 50 ] carrying dense metric depth and calibrated poses, drawn from structured light, LiDAR, and offline reconstruction. None of these covers the visual distribution of real manipulation, with its indoor setting and extreme viewpoint differences between fixed external and wrist-mounted cameras. DROID-3D is our contribution at this distribution and scale.

paragraphs.en: Depth-Aware Video Diffusion. Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) [ 5 ] provides strong appearance and motion priors but is trained on RGB alone. Three approaches have been explored to add depth into this prior. Marigold [ 16 ] showed that an image diffusion VAE encodes depth maps essentially without loss, repurposing the model as a depth predictor; DepthCrafter [ 13 ] extends this to video. Joint RGB–depth prediction has been pursued through channel expansion [ 49 , 47 ] , which adds depth channels to the VAE’s input and output convolutions and through dual-branch architectures [ 30 ] that run a parallel U-Net for depth with cross-connections to the RGB branch. Both modify the pretrained backbone substantially, preventing weight transfer. Our spatial latent tiling extends Marigold’s observation from single-image depth prediction to multi-view RGB–depth video prediction.
paragraphs.zh: 深度感知视频扩散模型。 Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) [ 5 ] 提供了强大的外观和运动先验，但其训练仅基于 RGB 图像。 已有三种方法被探索用于将深度信息融入这一先验中。 Marigold [ 16 ] 表明，图像扩散 VAE 几乎无损地编码了深度图，从而将该模型重新用作深度预测器；DepthCrafter [ 13 ] 则将这种方法扩展到了视频领域。 联合 RGB–深度预测通过通道扩展 [ 49 , 47 ]（在 VAE 的输入和输出卷积层中添加深度通道）以及双分支架构 [ 30 ]（为深度运行一个平行的 U-Net，并与 RGB 分支进行交叉连接）来实现。 这两种方法都大幅修改了预训练的骨干网络，因此无法进行权重迁移。 我们的空间潜在图分块方法将 Marigold 的结论从单图像深度预测扩展到了多视角 RGB–深度视频预测。

paragraphs.en: Robot Datasets and Their Calibration. Large-scale teleoperation datasets have grown rapidly in size and diversity—BridgeData V2 [ 38 ] , RT-1 [ 6 ] and the Open X-Embodiment aggregation [ 29 ] , RH20T [ 10 ] , and DROID [ 18 ] —however; almost all carry geometry as a byproduct of the capture pipeline: monocular RGB in Open X, single RGB-D in Bridge, and ZED stereo in DROID. Simulation-based corpora such as RoboCasa [ 26 ] and ARNOLD [ 11 ] carry perfect geometry but inherit the sim-to-real gap that motivates training world models on real data in the first place. DROID is unique among real-world manipulation datasets at this scale in providing synchronized multi-view stereo with known baselines and a publicly released URDF, but its shipped geometric metadata is not at the quality level downstream geometric learning depends on. Post-hoc recalibration of DROID has been attempted: PointWorld [ 14 ] initializes per-scene extrinsics from VGGT and refines them against robot depth observations, and serves as our baseline in § 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 机器人数据集及其校准。 大规模远程操作数据集在规模和多样性上迅速增长——例如 BridgeData V2 [38]、RT-1 [6] 和 Open X-Embodiment 聚合数据集 [29]、RH20T [10] 以及 DROID [18]——然而，几乎所有这些数据集都将几何信息作为采集流程的副产物附带提供：Open X 使用单目 RGB 数据，Bridge 使用单目 RGB-D 数据，而 DROID 则使用 ZED 立体数据。 基于模拟的数据集（如 RoboCasa [26] 和 ARNOLD [11]）虽然包含完美的几何信息，但也继承了“模拟到现实”的差距，而这正是最初需要在真实数据上训练世界模型的原因。 在如此规模的真实世界操作数据集中，DROID 的独特之处在于它提供了同步的多视角立体数据（具有已知的基线距离），并公开发布了 URDF；但其随附的几何元数据质量尚未达到下游几何学习所依赖的水平。 已有尝试对 DROID 进行事后重新校准：PointWorld [14] 从 VGGT 初始化每个场景的外参，并通过与机器人深度观察数据进行对比进行优化，该方法在 §5 中作为我们的基线方法使用。

paragraphs.en: The recent progress in learning-based geometric vision models rests heavily on large-scale datasets providing dense metric depth and calibrated camera poses. The manipulation domain lacks these resources at a comparable scale. While large teleoperation datasets like DROID [ 18 ] provide the necessary visual diversity and embodied dynamics, their raw geometric annotations are not at the supervision quality required for geometric pretraining.

paragraphs.en: We propose an approach that takes a multi-view stereo teleoperation dataset with a known kinematic model (URDF) as input and produces a calibrated RGB-D corpus in the robot’s coordinate frame. Our approach addresses the domain’s unique visual and calibration challenges in two distinct stages, shown in Figure 2 and described in the following sections.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种方法，该方法以包含已知运动学模型（URDF）的多视角立体远程操作数据集作为输入，并生成在机器人坐标系中经过校准的 RGB-D 语料库。 我们的方法通过两个不同的阶段来解决该领域特有的视觉和校准挑战，如图 2 所示，并在后续章节中进行描述。

sents.en: We propose an approach that takes a multi-view stereo teleoperation dataset with a known kinematic model (URDF) as input and produces a calibrated RGB-D corpus in the robot’s coordinate frame.
sents.zh: 我们提出了一种方法，该方法以包含已知运动学模型（URDF）的多视角立体远程操作数据集作为输入，并生成在机器人坐标系中经过校准的 RGB-D 语料库。

sents.en: Our approach addresses the domain’s unique visual and calibration challenges in two distinct stages, shown in Figure 2 and described in the following sections.
sents.zh: 我们的方法通过两个不同的阶段来解决该领域特有的视觉和校准挑战，如图 2 所示，并在后续章节中进行描述。

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 turns the independently calibrated cameras of each scene into an internally consistent rig placed approximately in the robot’s coordinate frame, good enough that the robot’s URDF can be rendered into each view and matched against the real image in Stage 2.
paragraphs.zh: 第一阶段将每个场景中独立校准的摄像头转换为一个内部一致的系统，该系统大致位于机器人的坐标框架内，这样机器人的 URDF 就可以被渲染到每个视图中，并在第二阶段与真实图像进行匹配。

paragraphs.en: Per-View Metric Depth. Each camera is a calibrated stereo pair with a known baseline b b and focal length f f , so metric depth reduces to predicting per-pixel disparity d d , with z = f ​ b / d z=fb/d . Manipulation scenes are dominated by textureless tabletops and specular robot arms, causing classical stereo SDKs to fail. To overcome this visual ambiguity, we recover per-view metric depth from each stereo pair using a learned global-matching network, S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} [ 25 ] . This provides the boundary-sharp metric signal necessary to turn cross-view pixel correspondences into reliable 3D constraints (see Appendix A.1 for an ablation against monocular and SDK baselines).
paragraphs.zh: 每视图度量深度。 每个相机都是一个经过校准的立体相机对，具有已知的基线 b 和焦距 f，因此度量深度问题简化为预测每个像素的视差 d，其中 z = f b / d。 操作场景主要由无纹理的桌面和镜面反射的机械臂主导，导致传统的立体视觉 SDK 无法正常工作。 为了克服这种视觉模糊性，我们使用一个学习到的全局匹配网络 S²M² [25]，从每个立体相机对中恢复出每视图的度量深度。 这提供了边界清晰的度量信号，能够将跨视图的像素对应关系转化为可靠的三维约束（关于与单目和 SDK 基线方法的消融分析，请参见附录 A.1）。

paragraphs.en: Multi-View Consistency. The initial camera calibrations lack full multi-view consistency, and the extreme viewpoint differences between external and wrist-mounted cameras defeat sparse keypoint matchers. We utilize the metric depth above alongside dense feature matching via RoMa v2 [ 9 ] to perform robust bundle adjustment. Because wrist–external matches are markedly noisier than external–external ones, a joint solve over all three cameras settles in poor local minima, so we optimize in two passes. Pass 1 aligns the two external cameras ( E 1 , E 2 E_{1},E_{2} ) into a consistent pair by minimizing their mutual Cauchy photometric residual. Pass 2 places this pair in the robot frame: the wrist camera pose is held fixed from forward kinematics and the factory hand-eye prior, and a single global S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) transform of the external pair is solved to best explain the wrist–external correspondences. The output is a per-scene rig that is only approximately in the robot’s base frame, since it still inherits the systematic hand-eye and joint-encoder errors of the factory priors; removing these is the role of Stage 2. Details of the two-pass formulation, correspondence filtering, and sparse-matcher failure modes are in Appendix A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 多视角一致性。 初始的相机校准缺乏完整的多视角一致性，而外部相机与腕部相机之间的极端视角差异会破坏稀疏关键点匹配器。 我们结合上述度量深度和通过 RoMa v2 [9] 实现的密集特征匹配，执行稳健的捆绑调整。 由于腕部相机与外部相机之间的匹配比外部相机之间的匹配噪声明显更大，对全部三台相机的联合求解容易陷入较差的局部最小值，因此我们分两阶段进行优化。 第一阶段通过最小化两台外部相机（E₁, E₂）之间的相互高斯光度残差，将其对齐为一致的一对相机。 第二阶段将这对相机置于机器人坐标系中：腕部相机的位姿通过正向运动学和工厂手眼标定先验保持固定，并求解外部相机对的一个全局 SE(3) 变换，以最佳解释腕部相机与外部相机之间的对应关系。 输出是每个场景的相机标定结果，该结果仅近似处于机器人的基座坐标系中，因为它仍然继承了工厂先验中的系统性手眼标定误差和关节编码器误差；消除这些误差是第二阶段的任务。 两阶段公式、对应关系过滤以及稀疏匹配器失效模式的具体细节见附录 A.2。

paragraphs.en: The input to this stage comprises the visually consistent per-scene multi-camera rigs produced in Stage 1, alongside the robot’s URDF and raw joint encoder readings. The output is a set of refined camera extrinsics firmly anchored to the robot’s physical base frame, coupled with globally optimized, robot-specific kinematic parameters (hand-eye transform and joint encoder offsets).
paragraphs.zh: 本阶段的输入包括在第一阶段生成的、在视觉上保持一致的每场景多相机系统，以及机器人的 URDF 和原始关节编码器读数。 输出是一组经过优化的相机外参，这些外参已牢固锚定到机器人的物理基座坐标系中，并附带全局优化后的、针对该机器人的特定运动学参数（手眼变换和关节编码器偏移量）。

sents.en: The input to this stage comprises the visually consistent per-scene multi-camera rigs produced in Stage 1, alongside the robot’s URDF and raw joint encoder readings.
sents.zh: 本阶段的输入包括在第一阶段生成的、在视觉上保持一致的每场景多相机系统，以及机器人的 URDF 和原始关节编码器读数。

sents.en: The output is a set of refined camera extrinsics firmly anchored to the robot’s physical base frame, coupled with globally optimized, robot-specific kinematic parameters (hand-eye transform and joint encoder offsets).
sents.zh: 输出是一组经过优化的相机外参，这些外参已牢固锚定到机器人的物理基座坐标系中，并附带全局优化后的、针对该机器人的特定运动学参数（手眼变换和关节编码器偏移量）。

paragraphs.en: Achieving this physical grounding presents two primary difficulties. First, visual reprojection consistency is invariant to rigid drift. A camera rig can be internally self-consistent but physically misaligned with the robot’s coordinate frame, which breaks the object-arm spatial relationships required for manipulation. Second, it is notoriously difficult to disentangle scene-specific camera calibration noise from systematic, robot-wide errors, such as constant joint encoder biases or gradual hand-eye mount drift. Optimizing scenes independently simply absorbs these hidden, systematic errors into the per-scene extrinsics.
paragraphs.zh: 实现这种物理层面的基准建立存在两个主要困难。 首先，视觉重投影的一致性对刚性漂移保持不变。 相机装置可能在内部是自洽的，但可能与机器人的坐标框架在物理上未对齐，这会破坏操作所需的物体与机械臂之间的空间关系。 其次，将场景特定的相机校准噪声与系统性的、贯穿整个机器人的误差（例如恒定的关节编码器偏差或手眼安装架的逐渐漂移）区分开来，是极其困难的。 独立优化各个场景只会将这些隐藏的系统性误差吸收进每个场景的外参中。

sents.en: Second, it is notoriously difficult to disentangle scene-specific camera calibration noise from systematic, robot-wide errors, such as constant joint encoder biases or gradual hand-eye mount drift.
sents.zh: 其次，将场景特定的相机校准噪声与系统性的、贯穿整个机器人的误差（例如恒定的关节编码器偏差或手眼安装架的逐渐漂移）区分开来，是极其困难的。

sents.en: Optimizing scenes independently simply absorbs these hidden, systematic errors into the per-scene extrinsics.
sents.zh: 独立优化各个场景只会将这些隐藏的系统性误差吸收进每个场景的外参中。

paragraphs.en: We overcome these challenges through a joint factor graph optimization that pools visual and kinematic signals across all episodes of a given robot. By rendering the robot arm into the camera views using the URDF and matching it to the real images, we tie the extrinsics to the real world. By optimizing all scenes simultaneously, we cleanly separate transient, scene-specific extrinsic noise from the shared kinematic parameters, multiplying the correction signal for the latter by the number of episodes. Details are given next.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过联合因子图优化来克服这些挑战，该方法会汇总给定机器人所有回合中的视觉和运动学信号。 利用 URDF 将机械臂渲染到相机视角中，并将其与真实图像进行匹配，从而将外参绑定到真实世界。 通过同时优化所有场景，我们可以清晰地区分短暂且场景特定的外参噪声与共享的运动学参数，并将后者的校正信号乘以回合数量。更多细节将在下文中说明。

sents.zh: 通过同时优化所有场景，我们可以清晰地区分短暂且场景特定的外参噪声与共享的运动学参数，并将后者的校正信号乘以回合数量。更多细节将在下文中说明。

paragraphs.en: Kinematic Anchoring via Rendering. To supply the absolute anchor to the robot frame that cross-view consistency alone cannot provide (the first difficulty above), we render the robot arm into each external view utilizing the URDF, the corrected joint angles, and the Stage 1 extrinsic estimates, and use LoMA-G [ 27 ] to extract 2D-3D correspondences between the rendered template and the real image. Each match links a rendered surface point, whose 3D position in the robot frame is known from the URDF and forward kinematics, to a real-image pixel, yielding a robot-frame ground-truth signal independent of any cross-view photometric cue. Simultaneously, patch-level features [ 28 ] extracted by LoMA-G provide a featuremetric alignment term that yields sub-pixel signals in textureless regions. Rendering details (cropping, non-PBR shading) are given in Appendix B.1 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过渲染实现运动学锚定。 为了提供仅靠跨视图一致性无法提供的机器人坐标系的绝对锚点（即上述第一个难题），我们利用 URDF、修正后的关节角度以及阶段 1 的外参估计值，将机器人手臂渲染到每个外部视图中，并使用 LoMA-G [ 27 ] 提取渲染模板与真实图像之间的 2D-3D 对应关系。 每次匹配都将一个渲染的表面点（其机器人坐标系中的 3D 位置可通过 URDF 和正向运动学确定）与真实图像中的一个像素关联起来，从而获得一个独立于任何跨视图光度信息的机器人坐标系真值信号。 同时，由 LoMA-G 提取的局部区域特征 [ 28 ] 提供了一个基于特征的配准项，可在无纹理区域中产生亚像素级的信号。 渲染细节（裁剪、非 PBR 着色）见附录 B.1。

Two kinds of parameters enter the graph: per-episode corrections to the external camera poses, which absorb scene-specific calibration noise, and shared kinematic parameters of the robot itself, which are tied across every episode of the robot. paragraphs.en: where ρ ⁡ ( ⋅ , c ) \rho(\,\cdot\,;\,c) is the Cauchy loss with scale c c , s s indexes episodes, and i i indexes residuals within an episode. The five data terms each constrain a different part of the graph: Mahalanobis-whitened wrist–external 2D reprojections ( 2d ) and 3D metric lifting residuals ( 3d ) tie the kinematic chain of Eq. ( 1 ), and thus δ ​ T wrist \delta T_{\text{wrist}} and δ ​ 𝒒 \delta\bm{q} , to the external cameras; URDF-rendered robot reprojections ( l ) ground the external extrinsics to the robot frame; cross-camera constraints ( ee ) keep the external pair consistent; and featuremetric alignment ( f ) adds sub-pixel signal in textureless regions. The Tikhonov term λ q ​ ‖ δ ​ 𝒒 ‖ 2 \lambda_{q}\|\delta\bm{q}\|^{2} regularizes under-constrained components of δ ​ 𝒒 \delta\bm{q} , letting the more flexible per-episode parameters explain residuals in those directions.
paragraphs.zh: 其中，ρ⁡(⋅,c) ρ(\,\cdot\,;\,c) 是尺度为 c 的柯西损失函数，s 表示不同回合的索引，i 表示同一回合内残差的索引。五个数据项分别对图的不同部分施加约束：马哈拉诺比斯白化的手腕–外部2D重投影（2d）和3D度量提升残差（3d）将方程（1）中的运动学链与外部相机连接起来，从而将 δ T wrist \delta T_{\text{wrist}} 和 δ 𝒒 \delta\bm{q} 与外部相机关联；通过URDF渲染的机器人重投影（l）将外部外参锚定到机器人坐标系中；跨相机约束（ee）确保外部相机对的一致性；特征度量对齐（f）则在无纹理区域引入亚像素级的信号。Tikhonov项 λ q ​ ‖ δ ​ 𝒒 ‖ 2 \lambda_{q}\|\delta\bm{q}\|^{2} 对 δ 𝒒 \delta\bm{q} 中约束不足的部分进行正则化，使得每个回合中更灵活的参数能够解释这些方向上的残差。

paragraphs.en: Scalable Optimization. Solving this massive graph is bottlenecked by scale, but the Hessian exhibits a highly sparse block structure. We leverage a GPU-accelerated Levenberg-Marquardt solver using the Schur complement. This effectively eliminates the per-scene blocks, reducing the bottleneck to a highly efficient 13 × 13 13\times 13 global solve per iteration. This drops the computational cost from cubic-in- N s N_{s} to O ⁡ ( N s ⋅ 12 3 + 13 3 ) O(N_{s}\cdot 12^{3}+13^{3}) , keeping typical wall time to roughly 12.5 minutes per robot group.
paragraphs.zh: 可扩展优化。 求解这个巨型图时，规模是性能瓶颈，但海森矩阵呈现出高度稀疏的块状结构。 我们利用基于 GPU 加速的 Levenberg-Marquardt 求解器，并结合舒尔补方法。 这有效消除了每个场景的局部块，将瓶颈降至每次迭代仅需高效求解一个 13 × 13 的全局问题。 这将计算成本从与 N_s 相关的三次方降低到 O(N_s · 12³ + 13³)，使典型运行时间保持在每个机器人组约 12.5 分钟。

paragraphs.en: We run this pipeline on DROID’s raw release [ 18 ] , the 71k-trajectory split that ships with the factory camera parameters. The recordings come from 13 institutions on Franka Panda arms, each with two table-mounted ZED 2 external cameras and a wrist-mounted ZED Mini. After per-robot filtering for broken metadata or unrecoverable initialization, we run across 28 robots and 13 labs covering 71,100 scenes . Calibration quality against a per-scene baseline is reported in § 5 ; hyperparameters and solver wall-time in Appendix B.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 DROID 的原始发布版本 [ 18 ] 上运行此流程，该版本包含随工厂相机参数一同提供的 71k-trajectory 分割数据。 这些记录来自使用 Franka Panda 机械臂的 13 家机构，每家机构均配备两台安装在桌子上的 ZED 2 外部摄像头和一台安装在手腕上的 ZED Mini。 在对每台机器人进行元数据损坏或无法恢复初始化的筛选后，我们共处理了 28 台机器人和 13 个实验室，涵盖了 71,100 个场景。 与每个场景基准相比的校准质量报告见 § 5；超参数和求解器的实际运行时间见附录 B.4。

paragraphs.en: The objective of DepthWorld is to generate video rollouts where predicted depth and RGB compose into a single, geometrically consistent 3D world, rather than just independent, visually plausible frames. We achieve this by consuming the dense metric depth and calibrated extrinsics of DROID-3D as a direct training signal.
paragraphs.zh: DepthWorld 的目标是生成视频序列，其中预测的深度和 RGB 图像共同构成一个几何一致的三维世界，而不仅仅是独立且视觉上合理的单帧画面。 我们通过将 DROID-3D 提供的密集度量深度和校准后的外部参数作为直接训练信号来实现这一目标。

sents.en: The objective of DepthWorld is to generate video rollouts where predicted depth and RGB compose into a single, geometrically consistent 3D world, rather than just independent, visually plausible frames.
sents.zh: DepthWorld 的目标是生成视频序列，其中预测的深度和 RGB 图像共同构成一个几何一致的三维世界，而不仅仅是独立且视觉上合理的单帧画面。

sents.en: We achieve this by consuming the dense metric depth and calibrated extrinsics of DROID-3D as a direct training signal.
sents.zh: 我们通过将 DROID-3D 提供的密集度量深度和校准后的外部参数作为直接训练信号来实现这一目标。

paragraphs.en: Integrating geometric prediction into state-of-the-art video world models presents two primary difficulties. First, modifying a pretrained backbone like Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) (e.g., via channel expansion or dual-branch networks) destroys the strong appearance and motion priors that make the model useful in the first place. Second, supervising depth independently per-view does not directly encourage 3D consistency across different cameras.
paragraphs.zh: 将几何预测整合到最先进的视频世界模型中存在两个主要困难。 首先，修改像 Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) 这样的预训练主干网络（例如，通过通道扩展或双分支网络）会破坏原本使该模型具有实用性的强外观和运动先验知识。 其次，按视角独立地监督深度并不会直接促进不同摄像头之间的三维一致性。

sents.en: Integrating geometric prediction into state-of-the-art video world models presents two primary difficulties.
sents.zh: 将几何预测整合到最先进的视频世界模型中存在两个主要困难。

sents.en: First, modifying a pretrained backbone like Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) (e.g., via channel expansion or dual-branch networks) destroys the strong appearance and motion priors that make the model useful in the first place.
sents.zh: 首先，修改像 Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) 这样的预训练主干网络（例如，通过通道扩展或双分支网络）会破坏原本使该模型具有实用性的强外观和运动先验知识。

sents.en: Second, supervising depth independently per-view does not directly encourage 3D consistency across different cameras.
sents.zh: 其次，按视角独立地监督深度并不会直接促进不同摄像头之间的三维一致性。

paragraphs.en: We overcome these challenges through two mechanisms. First, rather than altering the U-Net architecture, we introduce spatial latent tiling (§ 4.1 ) to exploit the Variational Autoencoder’s (VAE) natural ability to encode depth as an image, placing RGB and depth side-by-side in a wider latent grid. Second, to enhance cross-view consistency, we apply robot-frame auxiliary supervision (§ 4.2 ) through a lightweight point-map head that projects predictions into the robot’s physical base frame and supervises them against unified 3D point maps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过两种机制克服了这些挑战。 首先，我们没有改变 U-Net 架构，而是引入了空间潜在图块化（§ 4.1），以利用变分自编码器（VAE）将深度编码为图像的自然能力，将 RGB 图像和深度图像并排置于一个更宽的潜在网格中。 其次，为了增强跨视角一致性，我们通过一个轻量级的点云-地图头应用了机器人坐标系辅助监督（§ 4.2），该头将预测结果投影到机器人的物理基座坐标系中，并与统一的三维点云地图进行对比监督。

sents.en: We overcome these challenges through two mechanisms.
sents.zh: 我们通过两种机制克服了这些挑战。

sents.en: First, rather than altering the U-Net architecture, we introduce spatial latent tiling (§ 4.1 ) to exploit the Variational Autoencoder’s (VAE) natural ability to encode depth as an image, placing RGB and depth side-by-side in a wider latent grid.
sents.zh: 首先，我们没有改变 U-Net 架构，而是引入了空间潜在图块化（§ 4.1），以利用变分自编码器（VAE）将深度编码为图像的自然能力，将 RGB 图像和深度图像并排置于一个更宽的潜在网格中。

sents.en: Second, to enhance cross-view consistency, we apply robot-frame auxiliary supervision (§ 4.2 ) through a lightweight point-map head that projects predictions into the robot’s physical base frame and supervises them against unified 3D point maps.
sents.zh: 其次，为了增强跨视角一致性，我们通过一个轻量级的点云-地图头应用了机器人坐标系辅助监督（§ 4.2），该头将预测结果投影到机器人的物理基座坐标系中，并与统一的三维点云地图进行对比监督。

paragraphs.en: Marigold [ 16 ] showed that an image-diffusion VAE encodes and decodes depth maps faithfully. Building on this, we encode depth as a separate image alongside RGB and tile the two in latent space: each is encoded by the unmodified SVD VAE and placed side-by-side, so the U-Net sees a wider latent grid covering both modalities. The only network change is extending the spatial position embeddings to cover the wider grid.
paragraphs.zh: Marigold [ 16 ] 表明，图像扩散 VAE 能够忠实地编码和解码深度图。 在此基础上，我们将深度作为独立的图像与 RGB 图像一同编码，并在潜在空间中拼接这两者：每个图像都由未修改的 SVD VAE 进行编码并并列放置，这样 U-Net 就能看到覆盖两种模态的更宽潜在网格。 网络中唯一的变化是扩展空间位置嵌入，以覆盖这个更宽的网格。

sents.en: Marigold [ 16 ] showed that an image-diffusion VAE encodes and decodes depth maps faithfully.
sents.zh: Marigold [ 16 ] 表明，图像扩散 VAE 能够忠实地编码和解码深度图。

sents.en: Building on this, we encode depth as a separate image alongside RGB and tile the two in latent space: each is encoded by the unmodified SVD VAE and placed side-by-side, so the U-Net sees a wider latent grid covering both modalities.
sents.zh: 在此基础上，我们将深度作为独立的图像与 RGB 图像一同编码，并在潜在空间中拼接这两者：每个图像都由未修改的 SVD VAE 进行编码并并列放置，这样 U-Net 就能看到覆盖两种模态的更宽潜在网格。

sents.en: The only network change is extending the spatial position embeddings to cover the wider grid.
sents.zh: 网络中唯一的变化是扩展空间位置嵌入，以覆盖这个更宽的网格。

paragraphs.en: At each timestep, the model processes images of resolution 192 × 320 192\times 320 for V = 3 V=3 cameras (two external, one wrist) and two modalities (RGB, depth). Since the SVD VAE downsamples spatially by 8 × 8\times , each view-modality tile is independently encoded into a latent of dimensions H l ​ a ​ t × W l ​ a ​ t H_{lat}\times W_{lat} (where H l ​ a ​ t = 24 , W l ​ a ​ t = 40 H_{lat}=24,W_{lat}=40 ). We arrange the six tiles in a 2D grid: RGB and depth tiles for each view are concatenated horizontally (yielding width 2 ⋅ W l ​ a ​ t 2\cdot W_{lat} ), and the V V views are stacked vertically (yielding height V ⋅ H l ​ a ​ t V\cdot H_{lat} ). This produces a single joint latent of shape 72 × 80 72\times 80 per timestep (see Figure 3 ). The U-Net denoises this full grid as one tensor across a temporal window of 11 frames (6 history, 5 future) at 5 Hz. (See Appendix C.1 for the depth preprocessing pipeline required to conform the raw depth to the VAE distribution.)
paragraphs.zh: 在每个时间步中，模型处理分辨率为 192 × 320 的图像，来自 V = 3 个摄像头（两个外部摄像头，一个腕部摄像头）和两种模态（RGB、深度）。 由于 SVD VAE 在空间上以 8 × 8 的比例进行下采样，每个视图-模态图块都会被独立编码为维度为 H_{lat} × W_{lat} 的潜在表示（其中 H_{lat} = 24，W_{lat} = 40）。 我们将六个图块排列成一个二维网格：每个视图的 RGB 和深度图块在水平方向上拼接（得到宽度为 2 ⋅ W_{lat}），而 V 个视图则在垂直方向上堆叠（得到高度为 V ⋅ H_{lat}）。 这样，每个时间步都会生成一个形状为 72 × 80 的联合潜在表示（参见图 3）。 U-Net 以 5 Hz 的频率，在一个包含 11 帧（6 帧历史、5 帧未来）的时间窗口内，将这一完整网格作为单个张量进行去噪。 （关于将原始深度数据适配到 VAE 分布所需的深度预处理流程，请参见附录 C.1。）

paragraphs.en: Per-view depth denoising trains each predicted depth map against its own target independently, with no explicit penalty when predicted depths disagree across different camera views of the same scene. We make cross-view coherence explicit by lifting predictions into the robot base frame and computing the loss there.
paragraphs.zh: 逐视图深度去噪训练将每个预测的深度图与其自身目标独立进行对比，当同一场景的不同摄像头视角中预测的深度不一致时，不会施加显式的惩罚。 我们将预测结果转换到机器人基座坐标系中并在此处计算损失，从而明确实现跨视图的一致性。

sents.en: Per-view depth denoising trains each predicted depth map against its own target independently, with no explicit penalty when predicted depths disagree across different camera views of the same scene.
sents.zh: 逐视图深度去噪训练将每个预测的深度图与其自身目标独立进行对比，当同一场景的不同摄像头视角中预测的深度不一致时，不会施加显式的惩罚。

sents.en: We make cross-view coherence explicit by lifting predictions into the robot base frame and computing the loss there.
sents.zh: 我们将预测结果转换到机器人基座坐标系中并在此处计算损失，从而明确实现跨视图的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We do so by attaching a lightweight DPT [ 32 ] point-map head (initialized from VGGT [ 39 ] ) to the SVD U-Net’s final predicted latent x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} . For the predicted future frames x ^ 0 , f \hat{x}_{0,f} , we pass the (RGB, depth) latent pairs to the DPT head, which predicts a 3D point map in robot base coordinates for each view. The ground-truth point map P v , t ∗ ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 P_{v,t}^{*}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3} for view v v at frame t t is obtained by backprojecting the GT depth through the camera intrinsics and transforming it to the robot base frame via the calibrated extrinsics from § 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将轻量级 DPT [ 32 ] 点云映射头（初始化为 VGGT [ 39 ] ）附加到 SVD U-Net 的最终预测潜在表示 x ^ 0 \hat{x}_{0} 上来实现这一点。 对于预测的未来帧 x ^ 0 , f \hat{x}_{0,f} ，我们将 (RGB、深度) 潜在对输入 DPT 头，该头会针对每个视角预测机器人基座坐标系下的三维点云映射。 视角 v v 在帧 t t 时的真实点云映射 P v , t ∗ ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 P_{v,t}^{*}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3}，是通过将真实深度通过相机内参进行反向投影，并利用 § 3 中校准的外参将其转换到机器人基座坐标系获得的。

sents.zh: 视角 v v 在帧 t t 时的真实点云映射 P v , t ∗ ∈ ℝ H × W × 3 P_{v,t}^{*}\in\mathbb{R}^{H\times W\times 3}，是通过将真实深度通过相机内参进行反向投影，并利用 § 3 中校准的外参将其转换到机器人基座坐标系获得的。

paragraphs.en: The head outputs four channels per frame and view: spatial coordinates X , Y , Z X,Y,Z (the point-map prediction P v , t P_{v,t} in robot world frame) and a per-pixel confidence logit. We pass the logit through a softplus to obtain the positive confidence C v , t ​ ( u ) > 0 C_{v,t}(u)>0 . Following DUSt3R [ 40 ] and MapAnything [ 17 ] , the loss is confidence-weighted in log space, with Barron’s robust ρ \rho [ 3 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 头部每帧每个视角输出四个通道：空间坐标 X、Y、Z（机器人世界坐标系中的点图预测 P_{v,t}）以及每个像素的置信度 logit。 我们将该 logit 通过 softplus 函数，得到正置信度 C_{v,t}(u)>0。 遵循 DUSt3R [40] 和 MapAnything [17] 的做法，损失函数在 log 空间中进行置信度加权，并使用 Barron 的鲁棒 ρ [3]。

paragraphs.en: We initialize from the SVD checkpoint used by Ctrl-World [ 12 ] , utilizing identical action conditioning (per-frame end-effector pose). The combined training objective is ℒ = ℒ d ​ e ​ n ​ o ​ i ​ s ​ e + λ p ​ m ​ ℒ p ​ m \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{denoise}+\lambda_{pm}\mathcal{L}_{pm} . We train in two stages for stability. Stage 1 trains the joint RGB-depth model alone for 40,000 steps ( λ p ​ m = 0 \lambda_{pm}=0 ), allowing the model to learn the joint latent distribution. Stage 2 initializes the DPT head from VGGT and trains all components jointly for an additional 50,000 steps ( λ p ​ m = 0.005 \lambda_{pm}=0.005 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Ctrl-World [ 12 ] 使用的 SVD 检查点开始初始化，并采用相同的动作条件（每帧末端执行器姿态）。 联合训练目标为 ℒ = ℒ d ​ e ​ n ​ o ​ i ​ s ​ e + λ p ​ m ​ ℒ p ​ m \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{denoise}+\lambda_{pm}\mathcal{L}_{pm}。 为确保稳定性，我们分两个阶段进行训练。 第一阶段单独训练联合 RGB-深度模型 40,000 步（ λ p ​ m = 0 \lambda_{pm}=0 ），使模型能够学习联合潜在分布。 第二阶段从 VGGT 初始化 DPT 头，并联合训练所有组件，额外进行 50,000 步（ λ p ​ m = 0.005 \lambda_{pm}=0.005 ）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate both contributions empirically: the calibration quality of DROID-3D against a per-scene baseline, and the world model prediction accuracy on held-out trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对这两项贡献进行了实证评估：将 DROID-3D 的校准质量与逐场景基线进行比较，并评估其在保留轨迹上的世界模型预测准确性。

paragraphs.en: DROID-3D evaluation setup and baseline. We evaluate calibration on 5 DROID labs ( ∼ \sim 1,000 scenes total). Our baseline is a per-scene refinement procedure modeled on PointWorld [ 14 ] : VGGT [ 39 ] extrinsic initialization followed by per-scene optimization against robot depth, with S 2 M 2 [ 25 ] substituted as the depth source to match ours. We use four geometric proxy metrics: ext–ext ( EE ) and wrist–ext ( WE ) reprojection error on MAGSAC [ 1 ] gold inliers, robot depth error ( RD ) between S 2 M 2 and URDF-rendered depth, and Mask IoU between the URDF-rendered robot mask and a RoboEngine [ 46 ] segmentation. Full definitions are in Appendices D.1 – D.2 .
paragraphs.zh: DROID-3D 评估设置与基线。 我们在 5 个 DROID 实验室（总计 ∼ \sim 1,000 个场景）上评估校准效果。 我们的基线是一种基于 PointWorld [ 14 ] 的场景级优化流程：首先使用 VGGT [ 39 ] 进行外参初始化，然后针对机器人深度数据对每个场景进行优化，并将 S 2 M 2 [ 25 ] 替换为深度源以匹配我们的设置。 我们使用了四个几何代理指标：基于 MAGSAC [ 1 ] 黄金内点集的外参–外参（EE）和手腕–外参（WE）重投影误差、S 2 M 2 与 URDF 渲染深度之间的机器人深度误差（RD），以及 URDF 渲染的机器人掩码与 RoboEngine [ 46 ] 分割结果之间的掩码 IoU。 完整定义见附录 D.1 – D.2。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, we replicated the DROID setup in our lab and recorded 5 5 ground truth (GT) poses of the cameras as well as the robot joint offsets using a ChArUco board. Using this GT setup, we measure the average rotation error and translation error in the optimized poses. We test the pose accuracy using 50 50 synthetic scenes from the REALM simulator [ 37 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 此外，我们在实验室中复现了 DROID 的设置，并使用 ChArUco 板记录了摄像机的 5 个真实（GT）姿态以及机器人关节偏移量。 利用这一真实设置，我们测量了优化后姿态的平均旋转误差和平移误差。 我们使用 REALM 模拟器 [37] 生成的 50 个合成场景来测试姿态的准确性。

sents.en: Additionally, we replicated the DROID setup in our lab and recorded 5 5 ground truth (GT) poses of the cameras as well as the robot joint offsets using a ChArUco board.

paragraphs.en: DROID-3D calibration accuracy. Table 1 reports results on the full evaluation set and on the subset where the baseline converges. paragraphs.en: Accuracy to GT poses. paragraphs.en: World model evaluation setup and metrics. We evaluate on 256 held-out trajectories from DROID with 10 consecutive autoregressive rollouts. We compare three variants: RGB is the Ctrl-World [ 12 ] backbone (multi-view RGB only); RGB+D is our joint RGB-depth model; RGB+D PM-DPT adds the point-map auxiliary head. We report PSNR, SSIM [ 42 ] , and LPIPS [ 48 ] for RGB, and AbsRel, RMSE, and δ 1 \delta_{1} for depth, each computed separately for external and wrist views. Depth metrics are against the depth obtained in Sec. 3 . Full protocol is in Appendix D.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 世界模型评估设置与指标。 我们在 DROID 中预留的 256 条轨迹上进行评估，并采用 10 次连续自回归推理。 我们比较了三种变体：RGB 是 Ctrl-World [ 12 ] 的骨干网络（仅多视角 RGB）；RGB+D 是我们的联合 RGB-深度模型；RGB+D PM-DPT 增加了点云-地图辅助头。 我们对 RGB 报告 PSNR、SSIM [ 42 ] 和 LPIPS [ 48 ]，对深度报告 AbsRel、RMSE 和 δ 1 \delta_{1}，各项指标均分别针对外部视角和手腕视角计算。 深度指标与第 3 节中获得的深度进行比较。 完整协议见附录 D.3。

paragraphs.en: Joint depth prediction improves RGB. Table 2 reports both modalities on the held-out set, with qualitative rollouts shown in Figure 4 . Adding depth as a joint prediction target through spatial latent tiling delivers a clear gain on RGB quality: RGBD models outperform the RGB-only baseline on all three RGB metrics with +1.48 dB PSNR on external views and +1.02 dB on wrist.
paragraphs.zh: 联合深度预测提升了 RGB 质量。 表 2 报告了两种模态在保留测试集上的表现，定性结果展示于图 4。 通过空间潜在分块将深度作为联合预测目标加入后，RGB 质量得到了显著提升：在所有三项 RGB 指标上，RGBD 模型均优于仅使用 RGB 的基线模型，其中外部视角的 PSNR 提升了 +1.48 dB，手腕视角则提升了 +1.02 dB。

sents.zh: 联合深度预测提升了 RGB 质量。

paragraphs.en: Point-map supervision and DROID-3D’s downstream value. Adding the point-map auxiliary loss (PM-DPT) further refines depth accuracy—especially on the challenging wrist view – while fully maintaining RGB generation quality. This suggests that mapping RGB and depth into a shared, spatially tiled latent space already encourages the U-Net to learn strong cross-modality constraints. Consequently, the robot-frame auxiliary loss acts primarily as a fine-grained 3D regularizer rather than the sole driver of geometric learning. More broadly, PM-DPT serves as a working instance of how DROID-3D’s robot-grounded annotations can drive spatial supervision beyond independent per-view depth. This framework opens the door for future extensions, such as enforcing strict spatiotemporal (4D) consistency or enabling downstream policies to extract unified 3D representations directly from the world model’s internal latents.
paragraphs.zh: 点图监督与 DROID-3D 的下游价值。 加入点图辅助损失（PM-DPT）能进一步提升深度预测的准确性——尤其是在具有挑战性的手腕视角上——同时完全保持 RGB 生成质量。 这表明，将 RGB 和深度映射到一个共享的、空间分块的潜在空间中，本身就能促使 U-Net 学习到强大的跨模态约束。 因此，机器人帧辅助损失主要起到精细的三维正则化作用，而非几何学习的唯一驱动力。 更广泛地说，PM-DPT 展示了 DROID-3D 基于机器人的标注如何推动空间监督超越每个视角独立的深度预测。 该框架为未来扩展提供了可能，例如强制实施严格的空间时间（4D）一致性，或使下游策略能够直接从世界模型的内部潜在变量中提取统一的三维表示。

paragraphs.en: Cross-view consistency improvements. We measure two quantities: (i) Cross-view reprojection: We warp one generated external view into the other using GT depth and poses. RGB+D model beats the RGB baseline model by +1.0 dB PSNR (17.60 vs. 16.60), and our PM-DPT head always improves by + 0.05 +0.05 – 0.08 0.08 dB over RGB+D. (ii) Cross-view generated-depth agreement: Our PM-DPT model reduces external-view projected depth disagreement by 2.6 2.6 mm compared to our RGBD model.
paragraphs.zh: 跨视角一致性改进。 我们测量两个量：(i) 跨视角重投影：我们使用真实深度和姿态，将其中一个生成的外部视角变换到另一个视角中。 RGB+D 模型比 RGB 基线模型在 PSNR 上提升了 +1.0 dB（17.60 对比 16.60），而我们的 PM-DPT 头在 RGB+D 基础上始终能提升 +0.05 – 0.08 dB。 (ii) 跨视角生成深度的一致性：与我们的 RGBD 模型相比，我们的 PM-DPT 模型将外部视角投影深度的差异减少了 2.6 mm。

paragraphs.en: Comparison with other baselines. We compare against the existing world models for manipulation that predict future 3D geometry rather than RGB alone: PointWorld (PW) [ 14 ] , which predicts 3D scene flow and is the only action-conditioned 3D world model trained on DROID, and TesserAct [ 49 ] , which predicts RGB-D-normal video; iMoWM [ 47 ] has no public code. TesserAct is text-conditioned and single-view, so it is incomparable as is; we adapted it to action conditioning and trained it on the same DROID split. At 50k steps it trails our model: external PSNR 19.43 vs 24.07 (ours), AbsRel 0.154 vs 0.074 (ours); see Appendix D.5 for the adaptation and protocol. For PW, whose output is a point cloud rather than depth images, we compare predicted 3D trajectories of scene points (robot excluded), each model scored on its own depth target; see Appendix D.4 , Table A5 , and Figure A11 . Tracked-point ℓ 2 \ell_{2} (2 → \to 8 s): PW 23 → \to 56 mm, ours 31 → \to 46 mm. Chamfer: whole scene PW 8 → \to 18 mm vs. ours 8 → \to 9 mm; moving region PW 21 → \to 58 mm vs. ours 25 → \to 32 mm.

paragraphs.en: Depth quality is strongly view-dependent across both depth-augmented variants: δ 1 > 0.94 \delta_{1}>0.94 on external views but ≈ 0.82 \approx 0.82 on wrist due to the wrist camera’s rapid motion, proximity to the manipulated object, and frequent self-occlusion by the arm.
paragraphs.zh: 深度质量在两种增强深度的变体中都强烈依赖于视角：在外部视角上，δ₁ > 0.94 \delta_{1}>0.94；但在手腕视角上则约为 0.82 \approx 0.82，这是因为手腕摄像头运动迅速、与被操作物体距离近，且手臂经常造成自遮挡。

paragraphs.en: Limitations. As an autoregressive rollout model, DepthWorld inherits the exposure bias and quality degradation common to such models [ 12 ] . However, recent works like PersistWorld [ 2 ] have shown that RL post-training can significantly improve rollout stability. The availability of high-quality 3D annotations in DROID-3D, combined with the native 3D-consistent outputs of DepthWorld, opens exciting new frontiers for geometric reward design in future world modelling.

paragraphs.en: We introduced two contributions toward 3D-consistent world models for robot manipulation. DROID-3D recalibrates the DROID dataset into a 3D corpus with dense metric depth and robot-grounded multi-view extrinsics across more than 70,000 episodes, through a factor graph that pools each robot’s episodes against shared kinematic parameters. DepthWorld consumes this signal in a Stable Video Diffusion-based world model that jointly predicts multi-view RGB and depth via spatial latent tiling. The central empirical finding is that at equal training budget, joint RGB-depth prediction improves RGB by +1.48 dB PSNR over an RGB-only baseline, while simultaneously yielding metric depth for downstream geometric reasoning. Together, DROID-3D and DepthWorld open a path toward world models whose rollouts compose into a single coherent 3D scene—the property all downstream uses, policy evaluation, improvement, and planning, depend on.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了两项贡献，旨在构建适用于机器人操作的三维一致世界模型。 DROID-3D 通过一个因子图重新校准了 DROID 数据集，将其转化为一个包含密集度量深度和基于机器人的多视角外参的三维语料库，涵盖超过 70,000 个任务实例；该因子图将每个机器人的任务实例与共享的运动学参数进行整合。 DepthWorld 利用这一信号，基于 Stable Video Diffusion 构建了一个世界模型，通过空间潜在图分块技术联合预测多视角 RGB 图像和深度信息。 核心的实证发现是：在训练资源相同的情况下，联合预测 RGB 和深度相比仅预测 RGB 的基线模型，可使 PSNR 提升 +1.48 dB，同时为下游的几何推理提供度量深度。 DROID-3D 和 DepthWorld 共同开启了一条通往世界模型的新路径：其模拟结果能够整合为一个连贯的单一三维场景——这是所有下游应用（包括策略评估、优化和规划）所依赖的关键特性。

paragraphs.en: This supplementary material is organized as follows. Appendix A and Appendix B detail the two stages of the DROID-3D calibration pipeline: per-view metric depth and multi-view consistency (Stage 1), and the robot-grounded joint factor graph with its explicit residual definitions, hyperparameters, and discarded design choices (Stage 2). Appendix C covers the DepthWorld architecture and training: depth preprocessing, spatial latent tiling, the point-map head, the training objective, the optimization schedule, and the inference rollout. Appendix D specifies the calibration baseline, the geometric calibration metrics, the world-model evaluation protocol, and the protocols for the comparisons with PointWorld and TesserAct.

paragraphs.en: Classical semi-global matching (SGM) algorithms yield metric scale but fail on the texture-poor tabletops and specular surfaces of the robot arm, resulting in sparse depth maps with characteristic holes. The learned ZED Neural mode is denser but remains semi-dense and is outperformed by S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} in both coverage and boundary fidelity. See Figure A1 for qualitative examples of the performance. Additionally, we found that on our GT setup with GT poses, S 2 M 2 (ours) beats ZED NEURAL on robot-surface depth against the URDF render on all sets (median errors 11.2–15.3 mm vs. 12.6–16.9 mm).
paragraphs.zh: 经典的半全局匹配（SGM）算法能够生成度量尺度的深度图，但在纹理贫乏的桌面和机器人手臂的镜面表面上表现不佳，导致生成的深度图稀疏且存在特征性的孔洞。 经过学习的 ZED Neural 模式生成的深度图更密集，但仍属于半密集类型，并且在覆盖范围和边界保真度方面均不如 S^{2}M^{2}。 关于性能表现的定性示例，请参见图 A1。 此外，我们在配备真实位姿（GT poses）的真实场景设置中发现，在所有数据集上，S^{2}M^{2}（我们的方法）在机器人表面深度方面优于 ZED NEURAL，尤其是在与 URDF 渲染结果的对比中（中位数误差为 11.2–15.3 毫米，而 ZED NEURAL 为 12.6–16.9 毫米）。

paragraphs.en: Feed-forward monocular models, such as [ 21 ] , provide dense, visually pleasing depth but suffer from an inherent affine scale ambiguity. This lack of reliable metric scale causes severe misalignment during multi-view triangulation. In our specific case with Depth Anything 3 (DA3), we find that it generates noisy and overly smoothened depth maps, which fails to capture the details of the objects (see Figure A2 ). We further note that DA3 is itself distilled from a stereo teacher, and its own evaluation reports the stereo teacher to be the stronger depth predictor—consistent with our preference for a stereo source.
paragraphs.zh: 前馈单目模型（例如 [ 21 ]）能够生成密集且视觉效果良好的深度图，但存在固有的仿射尺度模糊性问题。 这种缺乏可靠度量尺度的特性会导致多视角三角测量过程中出现严重的错位问题。 在我们具体使用的 Depth Anything 3（DA3）模型中，我们发现其生成的深度图存在噪声过多且过度平滑的问题，无法捕捉物体的细节（参见图 A2）。 我们进一步注意到，DA3 本身是通过立体视觉教师模型蒸馏得到的，而对其自身的评估报告也指出该立体视觉教师模型是更优的深度预测器——这与我们对立体视觉来源的偏好一致。

paragraphs.en: Standard sparse keypoint detectors routinely fail to extract sufficient correspondences in this domain due to the extreme viewpoint differences between the fixed external cameras and the dynamic wrist camera, compounded by textureless surfaces: SIFT [ 23 ] , SuperPoint [ 7 ] + LightGlue [ 22 ] , and LoMa [ 27 ] all return too few reliable matches for bundle adjustment to converge, particularly on wrist–external pairs (Figures A4 – A6 ). We instead rely on RoMa v2 [ 9 ] to extract dense, pixel-wise correspondences even in textureless regions, robustly filtered using MAGSAC [ 1 ] fundamental-matrix estimation. Figure A7 shows the count of correspondences and the coverage across the frames for a small set of 25 25 samples.
paragraphs.zh: 标准的稀疏关键点检测器通常无法在此领域提取足够的对应点，这是因为固定外部摄像头与动态手腕摄像头之间存在极端的视角差异，再加上表面缺乏纹理：SIFT [ 23 ]、SuperPoint [ 7 ] + LightGlue [ 22 ] 和 LoMa [ 27 ] 返回的可靠匹配点都太少，导致捆绑调整无法收敛，尤其是在手腕与外部摄像头之间的图像对中（图 A4 – A6）。 我们转而依赖 RoMa v2 [ 9 ] 来提取密集的全像素对应点，即使在没有纹理的区域也能做到，并通过 MAGSAC [ 1 ] 的基本矩阵估计进行稳健过滤。 图 A7 展示了一组包含 25 个样本的小数据集在各个帧中的对应点数量与覆盖范围。

paragraphs.en: To avoid suboptimal local minima caused by the noise disparity between external–external and wrist–external view pairs, the bundle adjustment is solved in two passes. Pass 1 locks the two external cameras ( E 1 , E 2 ) (E_{1},E_{2}) into a mutually consistent pair: using the metric depth to lift matched pixels, we reproject depth from one external view into the other and minimize the Cauchy photometric residual. This reliably reaches sub-pixel triangulation error on the external pair for the large majority of scenes. The resulting pair is internally consistent but its global pose in the robot frame remains undetermined (a 6 6 -DoF gauge freedom; metric scale is fixed by stereo depth). Pass 2 fixes this external pair internally and resolves its global 6 6 -DoF pose by anchoring it to the wrist camera’s forward-kinematic trajectory. The wrist pose at each frame is not a free variable: it is taken from the robot’s kinematic chain—forward kinematics on the raw joint angles composed with DROID’s factory hand-eye prior—and held fixed in this pass. We solve for the single global S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) SE(3) transform of the locked external pair that best explains the wrist–external correspondences, using a looser Cauchy scale to reflect the noisier wide-baseline matches. The output is a per-scene rig approximately in the robot’s base frame—approximate because it still inherits the systematic hand-eye and joint-encoder errors of the factory priors, which Stage 2 (Appendix B ) removes.
paragraphs.zh: 为避免外部-外部视角对与手腕-外部视角对之间的噪声差异所导致的次优局部最小值，束调整分两阶段求解。 第一阶段将两个外部相机（E₁, E₂）锁定为相互一致的配对：利用度量深度提升匹配像素，我们将一个外部视角的深度重投影到另一个视角中，并最小化柯西光度残差。 对于绝大多数场景，这一方法能可靠地将外部相机对的三角测量误差降至亚像素级别。 所得配对在内部是一致的，但其在全局机器人坐标系中的位姿仍无法确定（存在6-DoF的测度自由度；度量尺度由立体深度固定）。 第二阶段固定该外部相机对的内部一致性，并通过将其锚定到手腕相机的正向运动学轨迹上，求解其全局6-DoF位姿。 每一帧的手腕位姿并非自由变量：它取自机器人的运动学链——即基于原始关节角度与DROID工厂手眼先验组合的正向运动学结果——并在本阶段保持固定。 我们使用一个更宽松的柯西尺度（以反映噪声更大的宽基线匹配），求解已锁定的外部相机对的最佳全局SE(3)变换，该变换能最准确地解释手腕与外部视角的对应关系。 输出是每个场景的一个粗略配准结果，大致位于机器人的基座坐标系中——之所以是“粗略”，因为它仍继承了工厂先验中的系统性手眼误差和关节编码器误差，这些误差将在阶段2（附录B）中被消除。

paragraphs.en: The input to this stage is the set of visually consistent per-scene rigs from Stage 1, together with the robot’s URDF and raw joint encoder readings. The output is a set of refined extrinsics anchored to the robot’s base frame, coupled with globally optimized robot-specific kinematic parameters (hand-eye transform and joint encoder offsets).

paragraphs.en: To tie the rig to the physical robot, we render the arm into each external view with pyrender , using the URDF, the current joint angles, and the Stage 1 extrinsics. We extract 2 2 D– 3 3 D correspondences between the rendered template and the real image with LoMa-G [ 27 ] : each match links a rendered surface point—whose 3 3 D location in the robot frame is known from the URDF and forward kinematics—to a real-image pixel, yielding a robot-frame ground-truth signal independent of any cross-view photometric cue. LoMa-G internally computes DINO [ 28 ] patch features; we store these at the correspondences and PCA-reduce them to 64 64 dimensions to support a featuremetric alignment term [ 36 , 24 ] (the f term in Eq. ( 2 )) that provides sub-pixel gradients in textureless regions. Two practical details matter. First, we crop both the render and the real image tightly around the rendered arm before matching: this raises both the match count and the effective patch resolution ( 92 → 277 92\to 277 matches in Fig. A8 ). Second, we render with well-lit, non-physically-based (non-PBR) shading, which produces more stable and dense discrete correspondences for LoMa-G than physically-based rendering. Figure A9 shows the patch level features for rendered robot and the input image. We see that the patches between the render and the actual image align nicely. Note that the features produced by LoMa are higher resolution and align much better than raw DINOv2 features. Therefore, we use the LoMa generated features (which builds upon the DINOv2 features).
paragraphs.zh: 为了将系统绑定到物理机器人上，我们使用 pyrender 结合 URDF、当前的关节角度以及第一阶段的外参，将机械臂渲染到每个外部视角中。接着，我们通过 LoMa-G [27] 在渲染出的模板与真实图像之间提取 2D–3D 对应关系：每个匹配项都将一个渲染表面的点（其在机器人坐标系中的 3D 位置可通过 URDF 和正向运动学确定）与真实图像中的一个像素关联起来，从而获得一个不依赖任何跨视角光度信息的机器人坐标系真值信号。LoMa-G 内部会计算 DINO [28] 的图块特征；我们将这些特征存储在对应关系处，并通过 PCA 将其降维至 64 维，以支持一个基于特征度量的对齐项 [36, 24]（即公式 (2) 中的 f 项），该对齐项可在无纹理区域提供亚像素级的梯度信息。有两个实际细节需要注意。首先，在匹配之前，我们会将渲染图像和真实图像都严格裁剪到渲染出的机械臂周围：这既增加了匹配数量，也提升了有效图块分辨率（如图 A8 所示，匹配数从 92 增至 277）。其次，我们采用光照良好且非物理渲染（non-PBR）的着色方式，这种方式能为 LoMa-G 生成比物理渲染更稳定、更密集的离散对应关系。图 A9 展示了渲染机器人和输入图像的图块级特征。可以看到，渲染图像与实际图像之间的图块对齐效果良好。值得注意的是，LoMa 生成的特征分辨率更高，且对齐效果远优于原始 DINOv2 特征。因此，我们使用由 LoMa 生成的特征（该过程基于 DINOv2 特征构建）。

paragraphs.en: The graph is large but its Hessian is highly sparse: each episode’s 12 12 -DoF block couples only to the 13 13 shared parameters, never to other episodes. We exploit this with a custom GPU-accelerated Levenberg–Marquardt solver. Each iteration applies the Schur complement to marginalize all per-scene blocks, reducing the step to a dense 13 × 13 13\times 13 global solve over the shared kinematic parameters, followed by parallel per-scene back-substitution for the extrinsics. This drops the computational cost from cubic in N s N_{s} to O ⁡ ( N s ⋅ 12 3 + 13 3 ) O(N_{s}\cdot 12^{3}+13^{3}) , with a typical convergence wall time of ≈ 12.5 {\approx}12.5 minutes per robot group; in practice data loading, not the linear algebra, is the bottleneck.
paragraphs.zh: 该图规模很大，但其海森矩阵具有高度稀疏性：每个周期的 12×12 自由度块仅与 13 个共享参数耦合，绝不会与其他周期耦合。 我们利用一个定制的 GPU 加速 Levenberg–Marquardt 求解器来发挥这一特性。 每次迭代都应用舒尔补矩阵来边缘化所有场景内块，从而将步骤简化为对共享运动学参数的密集 13×13 全局求解，随后对场景外参数进行并行场景内回代。 这将计算成本从 N_s 的三次方降低到 O(N_s·12³+13³)，每个机器人组的典型收敛时间约为 12.5 分钟；实际上，数据加载而非线性代数操作是性能瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: We present some additional qualitative comparisons of the obtained poses by our method and the Point World based baseline method in Figure A10 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在图 A10 中展示了通过我们的方法以及基于 Point World 的基线方法所获得的姿态的一些额外定性比较。

paragraphs.en: Raw depth maps are converted to VAE-encodable grayscale images through a strict four-step pipeline designed to keep the depth inside the distribution the Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) VAE was pretrained on:
paragraphs.zh: 原始深度图通过一个严格的四步流程转换为 VAE 可编码的灰度图像，该流程旨在使深度保持在 Stable Video Diffusion (SVD) VAE 预训练时所用的分布范围内：

paragraphs.en: (1) We downsample to the 192 × 320 192\times 320 working resolution using unprojection and z-buffer min-pooling rather than bilinear interpolation, which preserves foreground geometry and prevents “flying pixel” artifacts at object boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 我们使用反投影和 z 缓冲器的最小池化方法，将分辨率下采样至 192 × 320 的工作分辨率（192\times 320），而非采用双线性插值。这种方法能够保留前景几何结构，并防止物体边界处出现“飞行像素”伪影。

paragraphs.en: (2) Depths are clipped to the 95th percentile of the per-camera distribution ( ≈ 3 \approx 3 m for external, ≈ 2 \approx 2 m for wrist) to bound the VAE input while preserving manipulation-relevant content.
paragraphs.zh: （2）深度被截断至每台相机的分布的95百分位数（外部相机约为3米，腕部相机约为2米），以便在保留与操作相关的内容的同时限制VAE输入。

paragraphs.en: (3) A log transform compresses the dynamic range, allocating more representational capacity to close-range objects where manipulation precision matters most.
paragraphs.zh: （3）对数变换可以压缩动态范围，为近距离物体分配更多的表示能力，因为操作精度在这些物体上最为关键。

paragraphs.en: (4) Values are normalized to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] to match the VAE’s expected input range, and the single channel is replicated to three channels.
paragraphs.zh: （4）将值归一化到 [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1]，以匹配 VAE 的期望输入范围，并将单通道复制到三个通道。

paragraphs.en: We opted for spatial latent tiling over dual-branch and channel expansion architectures. Dual-branch methods require running a parallel U-Net for depth, linked via cross-connections to the RGB branch, effectively doubling the parameter count and complicating the training dynamics. Channel expansion, on the other hand, increase the number of channels in the input and output layers of the model to incorporate the added modality. Our tiling approach leverages the observation that the SVD VAE naturally encodes replicated single-channel depth, allowing us to place RGB and depth side-by-side in a wider latent grid. This forces the single, unmodified U-Net to jointly denoise both modalities, learning geometric consistency without major changes to the architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 我们选择了空间潜在图块化方法，而非双分支和通道扩展架构。 双分支方法需要并行运行一个用于深度预测的 U-Net，并通过交叉连接与 RGB 分支相连，这实际上使参数数量翻倍，并复杂化了训练动态。 另一方面，通道扩展会增加模型输入和输出层的通道数量，以融入新增的多模态数据。 我们的图块化方法利用了这样一个观察结果：SVD VAE 能够自然地编码重复的单通道深度信息，因此我们可以将 RGB 和深度数据并排排列在更宽的潜在网格中。 这使得单一的、未经修改的 U-Net 必须同时为两种模态去噪，从而在不大幅改变架构的前提下学会几何一致性。

paragraphs.en: We ablated this choice empirically. Table A2 compares spatial latent tiling against a dual-branch model—a parallel U-Net for depth with cross-connections to the RGB branch, in the style of SyncVP [ 30 ] trained for around 70 70 k steps and evaluated under the autoregressive rollout protocol of Appendix D.3 . Different from [ 30 ] , we do not use the same noise for both the modalities as our earlier experiments showed that it allowed the model to cheat in the EDM diffusion formulation. Furthermore, the model was first trained on RGB-only data for 50k steps and then continued for 20k steps with the dual branch. We would like to note that this is not a 1-1 comparison, but was done due to the additional compute requirements of the dual branch setup, which required more GPU hours to run through extensive FSDP parallelism. For the channel expansion architecture, we simply double the number of channels in the input and output layers of the model to incorporate the added modality. We train this in a single stage for 70k steps. Spatial tiling performs better: it improves every RGB metric on both views (e.g. + 1.7 +1.7 dB PSNR on external and + 1.5 +1.5 dB on wrist), and matches or improves depth quality, with the dual-branch only marginally ahead on external RMSE. Therefore, this influenced our decision to avoid changing the architecture.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过实证方法排除了这一选择。 表 A2 将空间潜在图块化方法与双分支模型进行了比较——该双分支模型是一个用于深度预测的并行 U-Net，与 RGB 分支存在交叉连接，其设计风格参考了 SyncVP [30]；模型训练约 70,700 步，并依据附录 D.3 中的自回归展开协议进行评估。 与 [30] 不同，我们没有为两种模态使用相同的噪声，因为先前的实验表明，这种做法会导致模型在 EDM 扩散公式中产生作弊行为。 此外，该模型首先仅使用 RGB 数据训练了 50,000 步，随后继续以双分支模式训练了 20,000 步。 需要指出的是，这并非严格的 1:1 对比；之所以进行这种比较，是因为双分支架构带来了额外的计算需求，需要通过广泛的 FSDP 并行化运行，从而消耗更多 GPU 时间。 对于通道扩展架构，我们只需将模型输入和输出层的通道数翻倍，即可整合新增的模态。 我们以单阶段模式训练该模型，共 70,000 步。 空间图块化方法表现更优：它在两种视图的所有 RGB 指标上均有提升（例如，外部视图的 PSNR 提升 +1.7 dB，手腕视图提升 +1.5 dB），且深度质量与之相当或更优；仅在外部视图的 RMSE 上，双分支模型略胜一筹。 因此，这一结果影响了我们避免修改架构的决定。

sents.en: We ablated this choice empirically.
sents.zh: 我们通过实证方法排除了这一选择。

sents.en: Table A2 compares spatial latent tiling against a dual-branch model—a parallel U-Net for depth with cross-connections to the RGB branch, in the style of SyncVP [ 30 ] trained for around 70 70 k steps and evaluated under the autoregressive rollout protocol of Appendix D.3 .
sents.zh: 表 A2 将空间潜在图块化方法与双分支模型进行了比较——该双分支模型是一个用于深度预测的并行 U-Net，与 RGB 分支存在交叉连接，其设计风格参考了 SyncVP [30]；模型训练约 70,700 步，并依据附录 D.3 中的自回归展开协议进行评估。

sents.en: Different from [ 30 ] , we do not use the same noise for both the modalities as our earlier experiments showed that it allowed the model to cheat in the EDM diffusion formulation.
sents.zh: 与 [30] 不同，我们没有为两种模态使用相同的噪声，因为先前的实验表明，这种做法会导致模型在 EDM 扩散公式中产生作弊行为。

sents.en: Furthermore, the model was first trained on RGB-only data for 50k steps and then continued for 20k steps with the dual branch.
sents.zh: 此外，该模型首先仅使用 RGB 数据训练了 50,000 步，随后继续以双分支模式训练了 20,000 步。

sents.en: We would like to note that this is not a 1-1 comparison, but was done due to the additional compute requirements of the dual branch setup, which required more GPU hours to run through extensive FSDP parallelism.
sents.zh: 需要指出的是，这并非严格的 1:1 对比；之所以进行这种比较，是因为双分支架构带来了额外的计算需求，需要通过广泛的 FSDP 并行化运行，从而消耗更多 GPU 时间。

sents.en: For the channel expansion architecture, we simply double the number of channels in the input and output layers of the model to incorporate the added modality.
sents.zh: 对于通道扩展架构，我们只需将模型输入和输出层的通道数翻倍，即可整合新增的模态。

sents.en: We train this in a single stage for 70k steps.
sents.zh: 我们以单阶段模式训练该模型，共 70,000 步。

sents.en: Spatial tiling performs better: it improves every RGB metric on both views (e.g. + 1.7 +1.7 dB PSNR on external and + 1.5 +1.5 dB on wrist), and matches or improves depth quality, with the dual-branch only marginally ahead on external RMSE.

paragraphs.en: DepthWorld is trained on S 2 M 2 depth (Appendix A.1 ). To quantify how much the choice of depth source matters, we train two further models with identical architecture and training protocol that instead use the ZED Ultra and ZED Neural depth of the wrist and external cameras. All three models are trained for 50 50 k steps and evaluated under the autoregressive rollout protocol of Appendix D.3 ; Table A3 reports the results. Two caveats apply when reading the table. The RGB metrics are directly comparable across rows, since every model predicts the same RGB frames. The depth metrics are not: each model is scored against the depth source it was trained on, so they measure how faithfully a model reproduces its own supervision rather than its absolute metric accuracy.
paragraphs.zh: DepthWorld 是在 S 2 M 2 深度数据上训练的（附录 A.1）。 为了量化选择不同深度来源所带来的影响，我们训练了另外两个模型，它们采用相同的架构和训练协议，但分别使用手腕摄像头和外置摄像头的 ZED Ultra 与 ZED Neural 深度数据。 所有三个模型均训练了 50,500 步，并依据附录 D.3 中的自回归展开协议进行评估；表 A3 报告了相关结果。 阅读该表格时有两点需要注意。 RGB 指标在各行之间可以直接比较，因为每个模型都预测了相同的 RGB 帧。 但深度指标则不然：每个模型都是基于其训练时使用的深度来源进行评分的，因此这些指标衡量的是模型对其自身监督信号的忠实再现程度，而非绝对指标上的准确性。

sents.en: DepthWorld is trained on S 2 M 2 depth (Appendix A.1 ).
sents.zh: DepthWorld 是在 S 2 M 2 深度数据上训练的（附录 A.1）。

sents.en: To quantify how much the choice of depth source matters, we train two further models with identical architecture and training protocol that instead use the ZED Ultra and ZED Neural depth of the wrist and external cameras.
sents.zh: 为了量化选择不同深度来源所带来的影响，我们训练了另外两个模型，它们采用相同的架构和训练协议，但分别使用手腕摄像头和外置摄像头的 ZED Ultra 与 ZED Neural 深度数据。

sents.en: All three models are trained for 50 50 k steps and evaluated under the autoregressive rollout protocol of Appendix D.3 ; Table A3 reports the results.
sents.zh: 所有三个模型均训练了 50,500 步，并依据附录 D.3 中的自回归展开协议进行评估；表 A3 报告了相关结果。

sents.en: Two caveats apply when reading the table.
sents.zh: 阅读该表格时有两点需要注意。

sents.en: The RGB metrics are directly comparable across rows, since every model predicts the same RGB frames.
sents.zh: RGB 指标在各行之间可以直接比较，因为每个模型都预测了相同的 RGB 帧。

sents.en: The depth metrics are not: each model is scored against the depth source it was trained on, so they measure how faithfully a model reproduces its own supervision rather than its absolute metric accuracy.
sents.zh: 但深度指标则不然：每个模型都是基于其训练时使用的深度来源进行评分的，因此这些指标衡量的是模型对其自身监督信号的忠实再现程度，而非绝对指标上的准确性。

paragraphs.en: The depth source has a large effect. The model trained on ZED Ultra depth is worst on every metric of both views: AbsRel rises from 0.074 0.074 to 0.194 0.194 on the external view and from 0.266 0.266 to 0.461 0.461 on the wrist view, where Ultra depth is particularly sparse and noisy (Figure A1 ). Notably, the poor depth target also degrades RGB prediction, by 2.0 2.0 dB PSNR on the external view and 1.4 1.4 dB on the wrist view, even though the RGB supervision is unchanged. Sparse and noisy depth is therefore not a neutral auxiliary signal but actively harms the joint RGB–depth model, and a high-quality depth source is crucial for training it.
paragraphs.zh: 深度源具有显著影响。 在 ZED Ultra 深度数据上训练出的模型在所有指标上对两种视图的表现均最差：外部视图的 AbsRel 从 0.074 0.074 上升至 0.194 0.194，腕部视图的 AbsRel 则从 0.266 0.266 上升至 0.461 0.461；其中 Ultra 深度数据尤为稀疏且存在大量噪声（图 A1）。 值得注意的是，质量较差的深度目标还会降低 RGB 预测效果：外部视图的 PSNR 下降 2.0 2.0 dB，腕部视图则下降 1.4 1.4 dB，尽管 RGB 的监督信号并未改变。 因此，稀疏且含噪声的深度数据并非中性的辅助信号，而是会主动损害联合 RGB–深度模型；高质量深度源对于训练该模型至关重要。

sents.en: The depth source has a large effect.
sents.zh: 深度源具有显著影响。

sents.en: Sparse and noisy depth is therefore not a neutral auxiliary signal but actively harms the joint RGB–depth model, and a high-quality depth source is crucial for training it.

paragraphs.en: S 2 M 2 and ZED Neural depth, in contrast, yield very similar models. The RGB metrics agree to within 0.2 0.2 dB PSNR on both views, and the depth metrics are close, with S 2 M 2 slightly ahead on the external view and on wrist δ 1 \delta_{1} , and ZED Neural slightly ahead on wrist AbsRel. This is expected: the two depth sources are highly correlated ( ∼ 0.97 {\sim}0.97 correlation between their depth values), so they provide nearly the same training signal; where they differ is in coverage and boundary sharpness (Appendix A.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: S 2 M 2 和 ZED Neural 深度估计方法相比之下，生成的模型非常相似。 在两个视角上，RGB 指标在 PSNR 上的差异不超过 0.2 dB，深度指标也十分接近：S 2 M 2 在外部视角和手腕 δ 1 \delta_{1} 上略胜一筹，而 ZED Neural 在手腕 AbsRel 上略胜一筹。 这是可以预见的：这两种深度来源高度相关（其深度值之间的相关性约为 ∼ 0.97），因此它们提供的训练信号几乎相同；它们的不同之处在于覆盖范围和边界清晰度（附录 A.1）。

paragraphs.en: Table A4 isolates the contribution of the recalibrated extrinsics to this head: training PM-DPT with point-map targets built from DROID’s factory extrinsics instead of the refined DROID-3D extrinsics leaves RGB quality unchanged but gives worse wrist-view depth (AbsRel 0.233 0.233 vs. 0.220 0.220 ).

paragraphs.en: We initialize from the Stable Video Diffusion checkpoint used by Ctrl-World [ 12 ] and inherit its action conditioning unchanged: a per-frame 7 7 -dimensional end-effector action ( 6 6 -DoF pose plus 1 1 gripper state). Training proceeds in two stages for stability, for 90,000 90{,}000 steps in total. Stage 1 trains the joint RGB–depth model alone for 40,000 40{,}000 steps with λ p ​ m = 0 \lambda_{pm}=0 , letting the model learn the joint tiled-latent distribution. Stage 2 attaches the DPT head (VGGT fusion trunk and regressor reused, latent adapter learned from scratch; Appendix C.4 ) and trains all components jointly for a further 50,000 50{,}000 steps with λ p ​ m = 0.005 \lambda_{pm}=0.005 . We optimize with AdamW at a constant learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} (no schedule) and a global batch size of 64 64 . We maintain an exponential moving average (EMA) of the weights with decay 0.9999 0.9999 , and all reported results use the EMA model. Total training takes approximately two days on two H200 nodes.
paragraphs.zh: 我们从 Ctrl-World [ 12 ] 使用的 Stable Video Diffusion 检查点初始化模型，并保留其动作条件不变：每帧为 7×7 维的末端执行器动作（6×6 自由度的姿态加上 1 个抓取器状态）。 为确保稳定性，训练分两个阶段进行，总步数为 90,000 步。 第一阶段仅训练联合 RGB–深度模型 40,000 步，此时 λ p ​ m = 0，使模型学习联合瓦片潜在空间的分布。 第二阶段接入 DPT 头（复用 VGGT 融合主干和回归器，潜在适配器从头学习；见附录 C.4），并以 λ p ​ m = 0.005 对所有组件进行联合训练，持续 50,000 步。 我们使用 AdamW 优化器，学习率恒定为 10⁻⁵（无学习率调度），全局批量大小为 64。 我们对模型权重采用指数移动平均（EMA），衰减系数为 0.9999，所有报告结果均基于 EMA 模型得出。 在两个 H200 节点上完成全部训练大约需要两天时间。

paragraphs.en: At inference the model denoises the joint tiled latent over a temporal window of 11 11 frames ( 6 6 history, 5 5 future) at 5 5 Hz, using 50 50 denoising steps and a classifier-free guidance scale of 2 2 (matching Ctrl-World [ 12 ] ). The history frames are sampled sparsely over the past, following Ctrl-World [ 12 ] , rather than as the six immediately preceding frames. Each rollout starts from the first frame, with the history buffer initialized by repeating it; the model then generates 10 10 consecutive future chunks autoregressively, feeding each predicted chunk back as history for the next window. Reported metrics therefore reflect compounding prediction error from a single-frame start, rather than teacher-forced single-step error.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，模型以 5 Hz 的频率，在一个包含 11 帧（6 帧历史、5 帧未来）的时间窗口内，通过 50 次去噪步骤和 2 的无分类器引导尺度（与 Ctrl-World [12] 一致），对联合分块潜在表示进行去噪。 历史帧是从过去稀疏采样的，遵循 Ctrl-World [12] 的做法，而非直接采用前六帧。 每次展开都从第一帧开始，历史缓冲区通过重复该帧进行初始化；随后模型以自回归方式生成 10 个连续的未来片段，并将每个预测片段作为下一窗口的历史输入。 因此，所报告的指标反映的是从单帧起始时累积的预测误差，而非教师强制下的单步误差。

paragraphs.en: To recover metric depth from a predicted depth tile we invert the four-step preprocessing of Appendix C.1 : the depth tile is VAE-decoded, the three replicated channels are averaged back to one, values are mapped from [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] back through the inverse of the normalization and the inverse log transform, and the per-camera percentile clip is undone. The resulting depth is metric. The reference is the same S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} ground-truth depth of Appendix B , but passed through the VAE encode–decode round-trip before scoring. Measuring against the VAE reconstruction of the GT depth, rather than the raw GT, factors out the irreducible round-trip error that bounds any latent-space predictor, so the depth metrics reflect prediction quality relative to the best depth the latent representation can represent.
paragraphs.zh: 要从预测的深度图块中恢复度量深度，我们需要对附录 C.1 中的四步预处理过程进行逆向操作：首先对深度图块进行 VAE 解码，然后将三个复制的通道平均合并为一个，再将数值从 [0,1] 通过归一化的逆操作和对数变换的逆操作映射回去，最后撤销每台相机的百分位裁剪。 由此得到的深度是度量深度的。 参考数据与附录 B 中的相同 S²M² 真实深度一致，但在评分前会先经过 VAE 的编码-解码往返处理。 通过与 GT 深度的 VAE 重建结果而非原始 GT 进行测量，可以排除任何潜在空间预测器都无法避免的往返误差，因此深度指标能够反映预测质量相对于潜在表示所能呈现的最佳深度的相对水平。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a fair evaluation of our joint factor graph optimization against the per-scene refinement baseline (modeled on PointWorld), we modified the baseline’s depth source. Instead of using FoundationStereo as in the original PointWorld pipeline, we substituted our global-matching S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} depth. This isolates the performance delta specifically to the structural difference in the optimization (per-scene vs. robot-coupled joint graph) rather than a difference in depth predictors.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保对我们的联合因子图优化方法与逐场景细化基线（基于 PointWorld 构建）的公平评估，我们修改了该基线方法的深度来源。 我们没有像原始 PointWorld 流程那样使用 FoundationStereo，而是替换为我们全局匹配的 S^{2}M^{2} 深度。 这样就能将性能差异明确归因于优化结构的不同（逐场景优化 vs. 机器人耦合的联合图），而非深度预测模型本身的差异。

paragraphs.en: Because ground-truth extrinsics are unavailable for DROID, we define four geometric proxy metrics to evaluate calibration quality:
paragraphs.zh: 由于 DROID 没有可用的真实值外参，我们定义了四个几何代理指标来评估校准质量：

paragraphs.en: Ext-Ext (EE) Reprojection Error. The median pixel reprojection error between the two external cameras, computed on a gold-inlier set extracted via MAGSAC enforcing epipolar and Kabsch-based 3D alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 外-外（EE）重投影误差。 两台外部相机之间的像素重投影误差的中位数，该中位数基于通过 MAGSAC 提取的黄金内点集计算得出，并强制实施了基于极线几何和 Kabsch 算法的三维对齐。

sents.en: Ext-Ext (EE) Reprojection Error.
sents.zh: 外-外（EE）重投影误差。

sents.en: The median pixel reprojection error between the two external cameras, computed on a gold-inlier set extracted via MAGSAC enforcing epipolar and Kabsch-based 3D alignment.
sents.zh: 两台外部相机之间的像素重投影误差的中位数，该中位数基于通过 MAGSAC 提取的黄金内点集计算得出，并强制实施了基于极线几何和 Kabsch 算法的三维对齐。

paragraphs.en: Wrist-Ext (WE) Reprojection Error. The analogous median pixel reprojection error measured between the dynamic wrist camera and the fixed external cameras.
paragraphs.zh: 腕部伸展（WE）重投影误差。 在动态腕部摄像头与固定外部摄像头之间测量的类似中值像素重投影误差。

sents.en: Wrist-Ext (WE) Reprojection Error.
sents.zh: 腕部伸展（WE）重投影误差。

sents.en: The analogous median pixel reprojection error measured between the dynamic wrist camera and the fixed external cameras.
sents.zh: 在动态腕部摄像头与固定外部摄像头之间测量的类似中值像素重投影误差。

paragraphs.en: Robot Depth Error (RD). The median absolute difference (in millimeters) between the predicted S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} depth map and the depth obtained by rendering the robot URDF using the optimized extrinsics and joint angles.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人深度误差（RD）。 预测的 S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} 深度图与使用优化后的外部参数和关节角度渲染机器人 URDF 所得到的深度之间的绝对差中位数（单位：毫米）。

sents.en: Robot Depth Error (RD).
sents.zh: 机器人深度误差（RD）。

paragraphs.en: DepthWorld is trained on the calibrated episodes that constitute DROID-3D. Starting from the publicly released raw DROID split ( ∼ 75 {\sim}75 k trajectories with high-quality RGB, raw ZED SVO stereo, and factory camera parameters), per-robot filtering for broken metadata or unrecoverable calibration leaves the 71,100 71{,}100 episodes across 28 28 robots and 13 13 labs reported in Appendix B . DepthWorld trains on exactly these 71,100 71{,}100 episodes. We hold out 1 % 1\% as a validation set and report world-model metrics on 256 256 trajectories sampled at random from it. Because the holdout is random at the episode level, the held-out trajectories come from the same robots and labs seen in training; these numbers therefore measure held-out-trajectory prediction quality, not cross-embodiment or cross-lab generalization.
paragraphs.zh: DepthWorld 是在构成 DROID-3D 的校准过的片段上进行训练的。 从公开发布的原始 DROID 数据集（约 75 {\sim}75 k 条轨迹，包含高质量 RGB、原始 ZED SVO 立体视觉和工厂相机参数）开始，通过为每台机器人过滤损坏的元数据或无法恢复的校准信息后，最终保留了附录 B 中报告的 28 台机器人和 13 个实验室共 71,100 71{,}100 条片段。 DepthWorld 正是基于这 71,100 71{,}100 条片段进行训练的。 我们保留其中 1 % 1\% 作为验证集，并基于从中随机采样的 256 256 条轨迹报告世界模型指标。 由于验证集是在片段层面随机选择的，因此被保留的轨迹来自训练阶段已出现的相同机器人和实验室；所以这些数值衡量的是保留轨迹上的预测质量，而非跨实体或跨实验室的泛化能力。

sents.en: DepthWorld is trained on the calibrated episodes that constitute DROID-3D.
sents.zh: DepthWorld 是在构成 DROID-3D 的校准过的片段上进行训练的。

sents.en: Starting from the publicly released raw DROID split ( ∼ 75 {\sim}75 k trajectories with high-quality RGB, raw ZED SVO stereo, and factory camera parameters), per-robot filtering for broken metadata or unrecoverable calibration leaves the 71,100 71{,}100 episodes across 28 28 robots and 13 13 labs reported in Appendix B .

sents.en: DepthWorld trains on exactly these 71,100 71{,}100 episodes.
sents.zh: DepthWorld 正是基于这 71,100 71{,}100 条片段进行训练的。

sents.en: We hold out 1 % 1\% as a validation set and report world-model metrics on 256 256 trajectories sampled at random from it.
sents.zh: 我们保留其中 1 % 1\% 作为验证集，并基于从中随机采样的 256 256 条轨迹报告世界模型指标。

sents.en: Because the holdout is random at the episode level, the held-out trajectories come from the same robots and labs seen in training; these numbers therefore measure held-out-trajectory prediction quality, not cross-embodiment or cross-lab generalization.
sents.zh: 由于验证集是在片段层面随机选择的，因此被保留的轨迹来自训练阶段已出现的相同机器人和实验室；所以这些数值衡量的是保留轨迹上的预测质量，而非跨实体或跨实验室的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: PointWorld [ 14 ] and DepthWorld predict different things. PointWorld is a 3D scene-flow model: given a set of seed points in the robot frame at the anchor frame, it rolls out the future 3D position of every seed point. DepthWorld predicts future depth images per camera, from which 3D points are obtained by sampling the predicted depth at a pixel and unprojecting it with the calibrated intrinsics and extrinsics. Neither output can be scored directly against the other, so the protocol below lifts both to 3D points in the robot frame at the same tracked scene locations and scores them there. Two consequences of this design should be kept in mind. First, DepthWorld is only ever asked for the depth of a known pixel, which is an easier question than PointWorld’s task of predicting where an entire point set goes. Second, DepthWorld predicts depth in the latent space of the SVD VAE, whose encode–decode round trip alone has an error floor that PointWorld’s point representation does not have; how we account for this is described below.
paragraphs.zh: PointWorld [ 14 ] 和 DepthWorld 预测的内容不同。 PointWorld 是一种三维场景流模型：给定锚定帧中机器人坐标系下的一组种子点，它能推演每个种子点的未来三维位置。 DepthWorld 会预测每台相机的未来深度图像，随后通过采样预测深度图中的像素值，并利用校准好的内参和外参进行反投影，从而得到三维点。 这两种输出无法直接相互评分，因此以下方案将两者都转换为机器人坐标系下、位于相同跟踪场景位置处的三维点，并在此处进行比较评分。 需要牢记这种设计带来的两个影响。 首先，DepthWorld 始终只被要求预测已知像素的深度，这个问题比 PointWorld 需要预测整个点集去向的任务要简单得多。 其次，DepthWorld 是在 SVD VAE 的潜在空间中预测深度，而仅其编码-解码往返过程就存在一个误差下限，这是 PointWorld 的点表示所没有的；下文将说明我们如何处理这一问题。

paragraphs.en: DROID has no ground-truth 3D trajectories, so we build them from point tracks, following the procedure of the PointWorld repository exactly. On the anchor frame of each external view we place a 64 × 64 64\times 64 grid of query points and track them through all 41 41 frames with CoTracker3 [ karaev2024cotracker3 ] , the tracker used by PointWorld’s authors, at the native 192 × 320 192\times 320 resolution, which matches the depth resolution and avoids rescaling. At every frame each tracked pixel is lifted to 3D by sampling the ground-truth S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} depth of that frame and unprojecting it with the camera intrinsics and the calibrated camera-to-world pose of DROID-3D. Points with invalid depth ( z ≤ 0 z\leq 0 or z > 4 z>4 m) are discarded. We then keep only points inside the robot workspace, a box of [ 0 , 0.7 ] × [ − 0.4 , 0.4 ] × [ − 0.3 , 1.2 ] [0,0.7]\times[-0.4,0.4]\times[-0.3,1.2] m in the robot base frame; this removes floor, wall, and background tracks, which otherwise dominate the error. Remaining spatial outliers, mostly tracks that jump between depth layers, are removed with a multi-scale DBSCAN [ ester1996dbscan ] filter at radii 0.2 0.2 , 0.5 0.5 , and 1.0 1.0 m, dropping any track that is an outlier in a large fraction of frames. A point is labelled moving if its ground-truth displacement from the anchor frame exceeds 3 3 cm. Points on the robot arm, identified by the URDF silhouette dilated by 3 3 px, are excluded from all scored sets, for the reasons given next.
paragraphs.zh: DROID 没有真实轨迹的三维数据，因此我们根据点迹构建这些轨迹，完全遵循 PointWorld 存储库中的流程。 在每个外部视图的锚定帧上，我们放置一个 64 × 64 的查询点网格，并使用 CoTracker3 [ karaev2024cotracker3 ]（PointWorld 作者使用的追踪器）以原始分辨率 192 × 320 追踪这些点贯穿全部 41 帧，该分辨率与深度分辨率一致且无需重新缩放。 每一帧中，每个被追踪的像素都通过采样该帧的真实 S²M² 深度，并利用相机内参以及 DROID-3D 经过校准的相机到世界位姿将其提升至三维空间。 深度无效的点（z ≤ 0 或 z > 4 米）会被丢弃。 接着我们仅保留位于机器人工作空间内的点，该空间在机器人基座坐标系中是一个 [0, 0.7] × [−0.4, 0.4] × [−0.3, 1.2] 米的盒子；此举可去除地板、墙壁和背景轨迹，否则这些轨迹会主导误差。 其余的空间异常点（主要是在不同深度层之间跳跃的轨迹）通过多尺度 DBSCAN [ ester1996dbscan ] 滤波器在半径为 0.2、0.5 和 1.0 米时进行过滤，任何在大部分帧中表现为异常点的轨迹都会被剔除。 若某点相对于锚定帧的真实位移超过 3 厘米，则被标记为移动点。 位于机器人臂上的点（通过 URDF 轮廓扩大 3 像素识别）会被排除在所有评分集合之外，原因如下文所述。
