paragraphs.en: In PointWorld the robot is an input, not a prediction target: the arm enters as points computed from the joint states through the URDF (the gripper only, in the released checkpoint), and its training clouds are built with the robot cut out. Seeding it with arm pixels therefore asks it to predict the arm as if it were scenery, a case it never saw in training, and the arm disintegrates within a few frames. Excluding the robot also matches PointWorld’s own evaluation, whose scene flows exclude it by construction. More fundamentally, both models are conditioned on the robot’s actions, so for PointWorld the arm’s future position is simply forward kinematics of the given joints, and scoring arm points would test calibration rather than world modelling; the question worth comparing is how the scene responds, i.e. objects, cloth, and doors. Finally, the arm would otherwise dominate the metric: with the robot kept, about 178 178 points per window qualify as moving, against about 45 45 without it, so roughly three quarters of a robot-inclusive moving score would be arm motion that both models are handed. The exclusion has costs. DepthWorld receives no credit for rendering the arm, which a video model must do correctly. Because the mask is the dilated URDF silhouette, points on a grasped object right at the gripper are dropped as well, as in PointWorld’s own pipeline. Cables remain in the scene, since they move with the arm but are not part of the URDF.
paragraphs.zh: 在 PointWorld 中，机器人是输入而非预测目标：机械臂以通过 URDF（在已发布的检查点中仅包含夹具）从关节状态计算出的点形式输入，其训练云则是在排除机器人的情况下构建的。 因此，用机械臂的像素作为种子输入，会要求模型将机械臂当作场景的一部分进行预测——这是训练时从未见过的情况，导致机械臂在几帧内便分解消失。 排除机器人也与 PointWorld 自身的评估方式一致，因为其场景流在构建时就排除了机器人。 更根本的是，两个模型都以机器人的动作作为条件输入；因此对于 PointWorld 而言，机械臂的未来位置不过是给定关节的前向运动学结果，而评分机械臂上的点只会测试校准效果而非世界建模能力；真正值得比较的是场景如何响应，即物体、布料和门等元素。 最后，如果不排除机器人，机械臂将在指标中占据主导地位：保留机器人时，每个窗口约有 178×178 个点被判定为移动点，而不包含机器人时则只有约 45×45 个点；这意味着包含机器人的移动得分中，大约四分之三来自两个模型都已知的机械臂运动。排除机器人确实会带来代价。 DepthWorld 因正确渲染机械臂而得不到任何加分，而视频模型必须做到这一点。 由于掩膜是膨胀后的 URDF 轮廓，因此紧贴夹具的被抓取物体上的点也会被丢弃，这与 PointWorld 自身的处理流程一致。 电缆仍保留在场景中，因为它们随机械臂一起移动，但并不属于 URDF 的一部分。

sents.en: In PointWorld the robot is an input, not a prediction target: the arm enters as points computed from the joint states through the URDF (the gripper only, in the released checkpoint), and its training clouds are built with the robot cut out.
sents.zh: 在 PointWorld 中，机器人是输入而非预测目标：机械臂以通过 URDF（在已发布的检查点中仅包含夹具）从关节状态计算出的点形式输入，其训练云则是在排除机器人的情况下构建的。

sents.en: Seeding it with arm pixels therefore asks it to predict the arm as if it were scenery, a case it never saw in training, and the arm disintegrates within a few frames.
sents.zh: 因此，用机械臂的像素作为种子输入，会要求模型将机械臂当作场景的一部分进行预测——这是训练时从未见过的情况，导致机械臂在几帧内便分解消失。

sents.en: Excluding the robot also matches PointWorld’s own evaluation, whose scene flows exclude it by construction.
sents.zh: 排除机器人也与 PointWorld 自身的评估方式一致，因为其场景流在构建时就排除了机器人。

sents.en: More fundamentally, both models are conditioned on the robot’s actions, so for PointWorld the arm’s future position is simply forward kinematics of the given joints, and scoring arm points would test calibration rather than world modelling; the question worth comparing is how the scene responds, i.e. objects, cloth, and doors.
sents.zh: 更根本的是，两个模型都以机器人的动作作为条件输入；因此对于 PointWorld 而言，机械臂的未来位置不过是给定关节的前向运动学结果，而评分机械臂上的点只会测试校准效果而非世界建模能力；真正值得比较的是场景如何响应，即物体、布料和门等元素。

sents.en: Finally, the arm would otherwise dominate the metric: with the robot kept, about 178 178 points per window qualify as moving, against about 45 45 without it, so roughly three quarters of a robot-inclusive moving score would be arm motion that both models are handed. The exclusion has costs.
sents.zh: 最后，如果不排除机器人，机械臂将在指标中占据主导地位：保留机器人时，每个窗口约有 178×178 个点被判定为移动点，而不包含机器人时则只有约 45×45 个点；这意味着包含机器人的移动得分中，大约四分之三来自两个模型都已知的机械臂运动。排除机器人确实会带来代价。

sents.en: DepthWorld receives no credit for rendering the arm, which a video model must do correctly.
sents.zh: DepthWorld 因正确渲染机械臂而得不到任何加分，而视频模型必须做到这一点。

sents.en: Because the mask is the dilated URDF silhouette, points on a grasped object right at the gripper are dropped as well, as in PointWorld’s own pipeline.
sents.zh: 由于掩膜是膨胀后的 URDF 轮廓，因此紧贴夹具的被抓取物体上的点也会被丢弃，这与 PointWorld 自身的处理流程一致。

sents.en: Cables remain in the scene, since they move with the arm but are not part of the URDF.
sents.zh: 电缆仍保留在场景中，因为它们随机械臂一起移动，但并不属于 URDF 的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Tracked points become occluded over the horizon. Scoring whatever is valid at each frame shrinks the scored set over time and biases it toward easy, unoccluded points, which makes the error appear to decrease with horizon. We therefore score a fixed persistent set per window: the moving points that are valid in every frame of the horizon and that could be matched to a PointWorld seed (next paragraph), about 45 45 points per window. Error then increases with horizon, as it should. The set is defined from the ground truth and PointWorld only, never from DepthWorld’s predictions, so PointWorld is a fixed reference when different DepthWorld checkpoints are compared.
paragraphs.zh: 被追踪的点在视平线之外会被遮挡。 每一帧对有效点计分会随着时间的推移缩小计分集合，并使其偏向于容易识别且未被遮挡的点，这会让误差看起来随着视平线的延伸而减小。 因此，我们为每个窗口计分一个固定的持久集合：即视平线内每一帧都有效的移动点，并且这些点可以与 PointWorld 的种子点匹配（见下一段），每个窗口约有 45 个这样的点。 此时误差会随着视平线的延伸而增大，这与预期一致。 该集合仅根据真实数据和 PointWorld 定义，绝不会基于 DepthWorld 的预测；因此，在比较不同的 DepthWorld 检查点时，PointWorld 是一个固定的参考。

paragraphs.en: PointWorld. PointWorld was trained with up to 12,000 12{,}000 scene points, and seeding it with only the few hundred tracked points is out of distribution and understates it. We therefore seed it in distribution with 12,000 12{,}000 scene points sampled from the workspace-filtered, robot-masked anchor-frame point map of both external views, supply the robot as URDF points from the joint states as in its training, roll out the dense cloud with the released large DROID checkpoint, and read off the trajectory of each tracked point from its nearest dense seed (nearest-neighbour match on the anchor frame, accepted if closer than 1 1 cm). PointWorld thus receives full multi-view context but is scored on exactly the tracked points. DepthWorld. For each tracked pixel and frame we bilinearly sample the predicted depth of the corresponding external view, de-normalised to metric depth as in Appendix C.8 , and unproject it with the same intrinsics and pose used for the ground truth.
paragraphs.zh: PointWorld。 PointWorld 的训练使用了多达 12,000 个场景点，而仅用数百个追踪点作为种子则偏离了其分布范围，并低估了其能力。 因此，我们使用符合分布的 12,000 个场景点作为种子，这些点从经工作空间过滤和机器人掩码处理后的两个外部视角的锚定帧点云中采样；同时根据关节状态以 URDF 点的形式提供机器人信息（与训练时一致）；利用已发布的大型 DROID 检查点生成密集点云；并从每个追踪点最近的密集种子点读取其轨迹（在锚定帧上进行最近邻匹配，若距离小于 1 厘米则视为有效）。 因此，PointWorld 获得了完整的多视角上下文信息，但评分仅基于这些追踪点。DepthWorld。 对于每个追踪像素和每一帧，我们通过双线性插值采样对应外部视角的预测深度，并如附录 C.8 所述将其反归一化为米制深度，然后使用与真实数据相同的内参和位姿进行反投影。

sents.en: For each tracked pixel and frame we bilinearly sample the predicted depth of the corresponding external view, de-normalised to metric depth as in Appendix C.8 , and unproject it with the same intrinsics and pose used for the ground truth.
sents.zh: 对于每个追踪像素和每一帧，我们通过双线性插值采样对应外部视角的预测深度，并如附录 C.8 所述将其反归一化为米制深度，然后使用与真实数据相同的内参和位姿进行反投影。

paragraphs.en: For every window three depth stacks are available: the raw ground-truth S 2 ​ M 2 S^{2}M^{2} depth, the same depth after an encode–decode round trip through the SVD VAE ( VAE-GT , the reference of Appendix C.8 ), and DepthWorld’s prediction . The round trip is not lossless: on moving points it alone displaces the ground truth by about 45 45 mm (median), and because DepthWorld must operate in the VAE’s latent space, this is a floor its network cannot go below. Scoring DepthWorld against raw depth therefore charges it for the VAE floor, whereas scoring PointWorld against VAE-GT would penalise it for a smear it never produced. We compute the full 2 × 2 2\times 2 of {PointWorld, DepthWorld} × \times {raw, VAE-GT} and report the diagonal as the fair comparison: PointWorld against raw depth, and DepthWorld against VAE-GT. Each model is thus measured against the best target its own representation can reach. The off-diagonal entries are unfair in opposite directions and reverse the winner depending on which is chosen. As a sanity check, the raw depth stored with DepthWorld’s outputs lifts to exactly the same 3D points as our own ground-truth pipeline, ruling out any scale or alignment mismatch between the two pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: 每个窗口都提供三种深度堆栈：原始真实值 S²M² 深度、经过 SVD VAE（VAE-GT，见附录 C.8）的编码-解码往返处理后的相同深度，以及 DepthWorld 的预测。 该往返过程并非无损：对于移动点，仅这一过程就将真实值位移了约 45 毫米（中位数），而且由于 DepthWorld 必须在 VAE 的潜在空间中运行，这构成了其网络无法突破的下限。 因此，将 DepthWorld 与原始深度进行评分会将其归因于 VAE 的下限，而将 PointWorld 与 VAE-GT 进行评分则会因其从未产生的模糊效应而对其进行惩罚。 我们计算了 {PointWorld, DepthWorld} × {raw, VAE-GT} 的完整 2×2 矩阵，并将对角线元素作为公平比较：PointWorld 与原始深度比较，DepthWorld 与 VAE-GT 比较。 因此，每个模型都是相对于其自身表示所能达到的最佳目标进行测量的。 非对角线项在相反方向上都不公平，并且根据所选项的不同会改变获胜者。 作为合理性验证，与 DepthWorld 输出一起存储的原始深度能够精确提升为我们真实值处理流程中的相同 3D 点，从而排除了两个流程之间任何尺度或对齐不匹配的可能性。

paragraphs.en: We report two metrics in two regions, as medians over windows; the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error is averaged over the frames up to the horizon and the Chamfer distance is evaluated at the horizon frame. The tracked-point ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error is the Euclidean distance between the predicted and target 3D position of the same point, averaged over the persistent moving set; it penalises a point that lands on the wrong part of the scene and is only possible because the persistent set provides stable correspondences. The symmetric Chamfer distance, 1 2 ​ ( mean ​ NN ​ ( pred → target ) + mean ​ NN ​ ( target → pred ) ) \tfrac{1}{2}\bigl(\mathrm{mean}\,\mathrm{NN}(\text{pred}\to\text{target})+\mathrm{mean}\,\mathrm{NN}(\text{target}\to\text{pred})\bigr) , is correspondence-free and measures whether the predicted cloud occupies the right space, regardless of point identity. The moving region scores only moving points and tests whether the model predicts the manipulation itself. The whole scene scores all workspace points, subsampled to 8,000 8{,}000 per cloud for equal density, and is dominated by static structure: it mostly measures whether the scene is reconstructed without drift. A Chamfer distance much smaller than the ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error indicates that the predicted cloud has roughly the right shape but that correspondences have drifted.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个区域中报告两项指标，即窗口内的中位数；ℓ₂ 误差在时间范围之内的所有帧上取平均，而 Chamfer 距离则在时间范围末的帧上进行评估。 跟踪点的 ℓ₂ 误差是同一预测点与目标点的三维位置之间的欧几里得距离，并在持续移动点集上取平均；该指标会惩罚落在场景错误位置的点，而这种情况之所以可能发生，是因为持续点集提供了稳定的对应关系。 对称 Chamfer 距离为 1/2 × (mean NN(pred → target) + mean NN(target → pred))，它不依赖点对应关系，而是衡量预测点云是否占据了正确的空间，而不论点的身份如何。 移动区域仅对移动点评分，用于检验模型是否能预测出操作本身。 整个场景对所有工作空间点评分，但为保持密度一致，每个点云会子采样至 8,000 个点；该评分主要由静态结构决定，主要衡量场景是否在没有漂移的情况下被重建。 若 Chamfer 距离远小于 ℓ₂ 误差，则表明预测点云的大致形状是正确的，但点对应关系发生了漂移。

paragraphs.en: Table A5 reports the fair diagonal at 2 2 s and 8 8 s, and Figure A11 shows a representative window. PointWorld is more accurate on tracked moving points at short horizon ( 23 23 vs. 31 31 mm at 2 2 s) but degrades faster, and DepthWorld is ahead at 8 8 s ( 46 46 vs. 56 56 mm). On the whole scene the two are equal at 2 2 s ( 8 8 mm), after which DepthWorld’s Chamfer distance stays flat ( 9 9 mm at 8 8 s) while PointWorld’s grows to 18 18 mm: the depth-image representation reconstructs the static scene without drift, whereas PointWorld’s point cloud drifts as the rollout proceeds. In the moving region PointWorld is slightly ahead at 2 2 s ( 21 21 vs. 25 25 mm) and DepthWorld degrades far less by 8 8 s ( 32 32 vs. 58 58 mm). The DepthWorld model in this comparison is the RGB+D PM-DPT variant of Table 2 . We stress the asymmetries noted above: DepthWorld answers an easier query and is scored above its VAE floor. Against raw depth, PointWorld’s point representation retains a large advantage on moving objects, a representational cost of latent-space depth prediction that we consider an important direction for future work.

paragraphs.en: TesserAct [ 49 ] is a text-conditioned, single-view RGB–depth–normal (RGBDN) video model built on CogVideoX-5b-I2V [ yang2024cogvideox ] , a 5B-parameter image-to-video diffusion transformer. It is not comparable off the shelf: it has no action conditioning, sees a single camera, and was trained on different data. We therefore adapt it minimally to our setting and retrain it on the same episodes as DepthWorld at an equal step budget.
paragraphs.zh: TesserAct [ 49 ] 是一种基于文本的单视角 RGB–深度–法线（RGBDN）视频模型，构建于 CogVideoX-5b-I2V [ yang2024cogvideox ] 之上，后者是一个拥有 50 亿参数的图像到视频扩散变换器。 它无法直接用于比较：该模型不具备动作条件约束，仅能感知单个摄像头视角，并且是在不同的数据上训练的。 因此，我们对其进行了最小程度的适配以适应我们的场景，并在与 DepthWorld 相同的片段集上以相等的步数预算重新训练了该模型。

sents.en: TesserAct [ 49 ] is a text-conditioned, single-view RGB–depth–normal (RGBDN) video model built on CogVideoX-5b-I2V [ yang2024cogvideox ] , a 5B-parameter image-to-video diffusion transformer.
sents.zh: TesserAct [ 49 ] 是一种基于文本的单视角 RGB–深度–法线（RGBDN）视频模型，构建于 CogVideoX-5b-I2V [ yang2024cogvideox ] 之上，后者是一个拥有 50 亿参数的图像到视频扩散变换器。

sents.en: It is not comparable off the shelf: it has no action conditioning, sees a single camera, and was trained on different data.
sents.zh: 它无法直接用于比较：该模型不具备动作条件约束，仅能感知单个摄像头视角，并且是在不同的数据上训练的。

sents.en: We therefore adapt it minimally to our setting and retrain it on the same episodes as DepthWorld at an equal step budget.
sents.zh: 因此，我们对其进行了最小程度的适配以适应我们的场景，并在与 DepthWorld 相同的片段集上以相等的步数预算重新训练了该模型。

paragraphs.en: The TesserAct architecture is kept unchanged. Its patch embedding splits the latent into three modality streams (RGB, depth, normal), projects each, and sums them into one shared token sequence, and two additional output heads produce the depth and normal latents. The transformer is initialised from the public CogVideoX-5b-I2V weights rather than from TesserAct’s released RGBDN checkpoint, mirroring DepthWorld, which starts from the generic SVD checkpoint rather than from a depth-pretrained model. The single conceptual change is the conditioning signal. CogVideoX conditions on T5 text tokens passed as the cross-modal context of its joint-attention blocks. We replace these with action tokens: for each of the 9 9 frames of a clip, the 7-D end-effector pose and gripper state is mapped by a small MLP ( 7 → 1024 → 4096 7\to 1024\to 4096 with a SiLU non-linearity), added to a learned per-frame temporal embedding, and layer-normalised, giving 9 9 tokens of width 4096 4096 that occupy the T5 slot. Because CogVideoX-5b-I2V uses rotary position embeddings, the context length is free, so 9 9 action tokens replace the 226 226 padded text tokens without touching any transformer block. This mirrors DepthWorld’s per-frame end-effector action conditioning. For classifier-free guidance, the whole trajectory is replaced by an all-zero null trajectory with probability 0.05 0.05 , and the conditioning frame is dropped with the same probability.
paragraphs.zh: TesserAct 架构保持不变。 其补丁嵌入将潜在表示拆分为三个模态流（RGB、深度、法线），分别对每个流进行投影，然后将它们合并为一个共享的令牌序列；另外两个输出头则生成深度和法线的潜在表示。 该变换器基于公开的 CogVideoX-5b-I2V 权重进行初始化，而非使用 TesserAct 发布的 RGBDN 检查点，这与 DepthWorld 的做法一致——DepthWorld 是从通用的 SVD 检查点开始，而不是从预训练于深度数据的模型开始。 唯一的概念性改动是条件信号。 CogVideoX 以作为联合注意力模块跨模态上下文的 T5 文本令牌为条件。 我们将其替换为动作令牌：对于剪辑中每个 9×9 帧，7 维末端执行器姿态和夹爪状态通过一个小型 MLP（7 → 1024 → 4096，使用 SiLU 非线性）进行映射，然后与每帧的学习时间嵌入相加并进行层归一化，从而得到宽度为 4096 的 9×9 个令牌，占据 T5 的位置。 由于 CogVideoX-5b-I2V 使用了旋转位置嵌入，上下文长度不受限制，因此 9×9 个动作令牌可以替代 226 个填充的文本令牌，而无需改动任何变换器模块。 这与 DepthWorld 按帧对末端执行器动作进行条件设置的做法一致。 对于无分类器引导，整个轨迹会以 0.05 的概率被一个全零的空轨迹替代，同时条件帧也会以相同的概率被丢弃。

sents.zh: TesserAct 架构保持不变。

sents.zh: 这与 DepthWorld 按帧对末端执行器动作进行条件设置的做法一致。

sents.zh: 对于无分类器引导，整个轨迹会以 0.05 的概率被一个全零的空轨迹替代，同时条件帧也会以相同的概率被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: We use the same DROID-3D training episodes as DepthWorld, restricted to the two external cameras; the wrist camera is excluded, and each external camera is treated as an independent single-view sample, since TesserAct has no notion of a multi-view rig. Clips are contiguous 9 9 -frame windows at 5 5 Hz and 192 × 320 192\times 320 resolution, with the per-frame actions aligned to the same timestamps. Depth is the DROID-3D metric depth mapped to TesserAct’s log-grayscale encoding over 0.30 0.30 – 3.30 3.30 m and replicated to three channels; normals are computed geometrically from the depth; actions are percentile-normalised per dimension. This yields 144,436 144{,}436 training clips and 1,534 1{,}534 validation clips.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用与 DepthWorld 相同的 DROID-3D 训练片段，但仅限于两个外部摄像头；腕部摄像头被排除在外，每个外部摄像头都被视为一个独立的单视角样本，因为 TesserAct 没有多视角设备的相关概念。 片段为以 5 Hz 频率、192×320 分辨率生成的连续 9 帧窗口，且每帧的动作都与相同的时间戳对齐。 深度数据是将 DROID-3D 的度量深度映射到 TesserAct 的对数灰度编码（范围 0.30–3.30 米）并复制到三个通道中得到的；法线通过几何方法从深度数据计算得出；动作则按每个维度进行百分位归一化。 由此获得了 144,436 个训练片段和 1,534 个验证片段。

sents.zh: 我们使用与 DepthWorld 相同的 DROID-3D 训练片段，但仅限于两个外部摄像头；腕部摄像头被排除在外，每个外部摄像头都被视为一个独立的单视角样本，因为 TesserAct 没有多视角设备的相关概念。

sents.zh: 深度数据是将 DROID-3D 的度量深度映射到 TesserAct 的对数灰度编码（范围 0.30–3.30 米）并复制到三个通道中得到的；法线通过几何方法从深度数据计算得出；动作则按每个维度进行百分位归一化。

sents.en: This yields 144,436 144{,}436 training clips and 1,534 1{,}534 validation clips.
sents.zh: 由此获得了 144,436 个训练片段和 1,534 个验证片段。

paragraphs.en: The training objective is TesserAct’s own: given the VAE-encoded first RGBDN frame and the action trajectory, denoise the 9 9 -frame RGBDN clip with CogVideoX’s velocity target, with the loss being the sum of three separately weighted per-modality MSE terms. Each modality is encoded separately by the frozen CogVideoX VAE. Both the transformer and the action encoder are trained. We train on 16 16 H200 GPUs with data-parallel training in bf16 with gradient checkpointing, full-precision AdamW ( β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.95 \beta_{2}=0.95 , weight decay 10 − 3 10^{-3} , gradient clipping at 1.0 1.0 ), a global batch of 64 64 clips, and a constant learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} after a 200 200 -step warm-up. We train for 50 50 k steps (about 20 20 hours), matching the 50 50 k-step budget of the DepthWorld model it is compared against.
paragraphs.zh: 训练目标本身是 TesserAct 的：给定 VAE 编码后的首个 RGBDN 帧和行动轨迹，使用 CogVideoX 的速度目标对 9×9 帧的 RGBDN 片段进行去噪，其损失函数为三个分别加权、按模态计算的均方误差项之和。 每种模态都由冻结的 CogVideoX VAE 单独编码。 变换器和行动编码器均经过训练。 我们在 16 块 H200 GPU 上进行训练，采用 bf16 格式的数据并行训练，并启用梯度检查点机制、全精度 AdamW（β₁=0.9，β₂=0.95，权重衰减为 10⁻³，梯度裁剪阈值为 1.0），全局批量大小为 64 个片段，并在 200 步预热后采用 5×10⁻⁵ 的恒定学习率。 我们训练了 50,000 步（约 20 小时），与所比较的 DepthWorld 模型的 50,000 步预算相匹配。

paragraphs.en: We mirror the DepthWorld protocol of Appendix D.3 . Generation uses the released TesserAct pipeline without its text encoder: the action tokens are passed as the prompt embedding and the null trajectory as the negative embedding, with classifier-free guidance scale 6.0 6.0 and 50 50 DPM-Solver steps at 192 × 320 192\times 320 . Rollouts are autoregressive and closed-loop: five chained 9 9 -frame generations, each re-anchored on the last generated RGBDN frame (ground truth is never re-injected) and given the next 8 8 -frame action segment, producing 1 + 5 × 8 = 41 1+5\times 8=41 frames or 8.2 8.2 s, the same horizon as DepthWorld, which reaches it in ten steps of four new frames. The evaluation set is 128 128 held-out samples, each an episode with a fixed anchor frame scored on both external views; the two views are averaged with equal weight. As for DepthWorld, metrics are computed against the ground truth after an encode–decode round trip through the model’s own VAE (here the CogVideoX VAE), so that each model is scored above its own representational floor (Appendix C.8 ); we additionally record the error against raw depth and the VAE floor itself. Metric depth is recovered by inverting the log encoding, the conditioning frame is excluded, and the RGB and depth metrics of Appendix D.3 are averaged over the 40 40 generated frames.
paragraphs.zh: 我们遵循附录 D.3 中的 DepthWorld 协议。 生成过程使用已发布的 TesserAct 流程，但不包含其文本编码器：动作标记被用作提示嵌入，空轨迹则用作负向嵌入，配合无分类器引导尺度 6.0、6.0 以及 50、50 次 DPM-Solver 步长，在 192 × 320、192\times 320 的分辨率下运行。 展开过程是自回归且闭环的：连续进行五次 9、9 帧的生成，每次生成都以最后一个生成的 RGBDN 帧重新锚定（原始真值从未被重新注入），并输入下一个 8、8 帧的动作片段，最终产生 1 + 5 × 8 = 41、1+5\times 8=41 帧，即 8.2、8.2 秒，与 DepthWorld 的时间跨度相同；DepthWorld 通过十次各含四帧新画面的步骤达到该时长。 评估集包含 128、128 个预留样本，每个样本都是一个具有固定锚定帧的完整流程，并从两个外部视角进行评分；这两个视角以相等权重取平均值。 与 DepthWorld 类似，各项指标是在模型自身的 VAE（此处为 CogVideoX VAE）完成一次编码-解码循环后，基于原始真值计算得出的，这样每个模型的评分都高于其自身的表示下限（附录 C.8）；此外，我们还记录了与原始深度数据以及 VAE 下限之间的误差。 指标深度通过反推对数编码恢复，条件帧被排除在外，而附录 D.3 中的 RGB 和深度指标则在生成的 40、40 帧上取平均值。

sents.zh: 生成过程使用已发布的 TesserAct 流程，但不包含其文本编码器：动作标记被用作提示嵌入，空轨迹则用作负向嵌入，配合无分类器引导尺度 6.0、6.0 以及 50、50 次 DPM-Solver 步长，在 192 × 320、192\times 320 的分辨率下运行。

sents.en: Rollouts are autoregressive and closed-loop: five chained 9 9 -frame generations, each re-anchored on the last generated RGBDN frame (ground truth is never re-injected) and given the next 8 8 -frame action segment, producing 1 + 5 × 8 = 41 1+5\times 8=41 frames or 8.2 8.2 s, the same horizon as DepthWorld, which reaches it in ten steps of four new frames.
sents.zh: 展开过程是自回归且闭环的：连续进行五次 9、9 帧的生成，每次生成都以最后一个生成的 RGBDN 帧重新锚定（原始真值从未被重新注入），并输入下一个 8、8 帧的动作片段，最终产生 1 + 5 × 8 = 41、1+5\times 8=41 帧，即 8.2、8.2 秒，与 DepthWorld 的时间跨度相同；DepthWorld 通过十次各含四帧新画面的步骤达到该时长。

sents.en: The evaluation set is 128 128 held-out samples, each an episode with a fixed anchor frame scored on both external views; the two views are averaged with equal weight.
sents.zh: 评估集包含 128、128 个预留样本，每个样本都是一个具有固定锚定帧的完整流程，并从两个外部视角进行评分；这两个视角以相等权重取平均值。

sents.en: As for DepthWorld, metrics are computed against the ground truth after an encode–decode round trip through the model’s own VAE (here the CogVideoX VAE), so that each model is scored above its own representational floor (Appendix C.8 ); we additionally record the error against raw depth and the VAE floor itself.
sents.zh: 与 DepthWorld 类似，各项指标是在模型自身的 VAE（此处为 CogVideoX VAE）完成一次编码-解码循环后，基于原始真值计算得出的，这样每个模型的评分都高于其自身的表示下限（附录 C.8）；此外，我们还记录了与原始深度数据以及 VAE 下限之间的误差。

sents.en: Metric depth is recovered by inverting the log encoding, the conditioning frame is excluded, and the RGB and depth metrics of Appendix D.3 are averaged over the 40 40 generated frames.
sents.zh: 指标深度通过反推对数编码恢复，条件帧被排除在外，而附录 D.3 中的 RGB 和深度指标则在生成的 40、40 帧上取平均值。

paragraphs.en: At the same 50 50 k steps, averaged over the 40 40 generated frames on the external views, the adapted TesserAct reaches 19.43 19.43 dB PSNR and 0.154 0.154 AbsRel, against 24.07 24.07 dB and 0.074 0.074 for the DepthWorld RGB+D model (the S 2 M 2 row of Table A3 ): it trails by 4.6 4.6 dB and about 2 × 2\times in AbsRel. The gap is mostly one of rollout stability rather than single-step quality: TesserAct’s first generated chunk is reasonable (PSNR 23.55 23.55 , LPIPS 0.065 0.065 , AbsRel 0.082 0.082 , δ 1 \delta_{1} 0.95 0.95 over its eight future frames), but quality decays steadily along the rollout, from PSNR 27.9 27.9 , AbsRel 0.048 0.048 , and δ 1 \delta_{1} 0.97 0.97 at the first generated frame to 16.8 16.8 , 0.211 0.211 , and 0.81 0.81 at the fortieth, with no visible seams at the re-anchoring boundaries. Qualitatively, the generated arm follows the commanded trajectory over the full 8 8 s, indicating that the action conditioning is used. Two differences should be kept in mind when reading these numbers. TesserAct sees a single view and so has no cross-view context, whereas DepthWorld predicts all cameras jointly. Its depth also passes through the CogVideoX VAE, whose floor on raw depth is large (AbsRel 0.28 0.28 on one external camera), so its raw-depth error is dominated by the representation rather than the network; scoring both models above their own VAE floor, as we do, removes this effect from the comparison. The guidance scale was not tuned.
paragraphs.zh: 在相同的 50 50 k 步中，对外部视图生成的 40 40 帧进行平均后，经过适配的 TesserAct 达到了 19.43 19.43 dB 的 PSNR 和 0.154 0.154 的 AbsRel，而 DepthWorld RGB+D 模型（表 A3 中的 S 2 M 2 行）则分别达到 24.07 24.07 dB 和 0.074 0.074；前者在 PSNR 上落后 4.6 4.6 dB，AbsRel 则落后约 2 × 2\times。 这一差距主要源于展开过程的稳定性，而非单步质量：TesserAct 生成的首个片段表现合理（PSNR 为 23.55 23.55，LPIPS 为 0.065 0.065，AbsRel 为 0.082 0.082，δ 1 \delta_{1} 在其八个未来帧中为 0.95 0.95），但质量随着展开过程逐渐下降——从第一帧的 PSNR 27.9 27.9、AbsRel 0.048 0.048 和 δ 1 \delta_{1} 0.97 0.97，降至第 40 帧时的 16.8 16.8、0.211 0.211 和 0.81 0.81，且重新锚定边界处没有可见的接缝。 从定性角度看，生成的机械臂在整个 8 8 秒内都遵循了指令轨迹，表明动作条件化机制已被使用。 阅读这些数值时，应注意两个差异。 TesserAct 仅观察单个视图，因此没有跨视图上下文信息，而 DepthWorld 则对所有摄像头进行联合预测。 其深度数据还经过了 CogVideoX VAE 的处理，该模型对原始深度的下限限制较大（在一台外部摄像头上的 AbsRel 为 0.28 0.28），因此其原始深度误差主要由表示方式而非网络本身决定；如我们所做的那样，将两个模型的成绩均置于其各自 VAE 的下限之上，从而排除了这一因素对比较的影响。 引导尺度未经调整。

sents.en: TesserAct sees a single view and so has no cross-view context, whereas DepthWorld predicts all cameras jointly.
